Talent.Description: Add [BO] per rank of Uncanny Reactions to all Vigilance checks.

Talent.Name: Works Like A Charm
Talent.Description: Once per session, make one skill check using Presence rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.

Talent.Name: Pin
Talent.Description: Take Pin action; make an [B]Opposed athletics check[b] to immobilize an engaged opponent until the end of the character's next turn. Spend [TR] to extend duration one round.

Talent.Name: Museum Worthy
Talent.Description: Once per session, take Museum Worthy action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] to ascertain information regarding a relic, ruin, or piece of history.

Talent.Name: Bring It Down
Talent.Description: Once per attack, spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage to a single hit equal to target's Brawn value.

Talent.Name: Hunter's Quarry
Talent.Description: Take Hunter's Quarry action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to upgrade the ability of all attacks made against a target at long range until the end of the character's next turn.

Talent.Name: Hunter's Quarry (Improved)
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to perform Hunter's Quarry action as a maneuver.

Talent.Name: Burly
Talent.Description: Reduce any wielded weapon's Cumbersome quality and Encumbrance rating by a number equal to ranks in Burly to a minimum of 1.

Talent.Name: Fearsome
Talent.Description: When an adversary becomes engaged with the character, the character may force the adversary to make a fear check, with the difficulty equal to the character's ranks in Fearsome.

Talent.Name: Heavy Hitter
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend [TR] on a successful Ranged (Heavy) or Gunnery check to add the Breach 1 quality to the attack, or increase an existing Breach rating by 1.

Talent.Name: Heroic Resilience
Talent.Description: Immediately after being hit by an attack but before suffering damage, spend 1 Destiny Point to increase soak by ranks in Resilience.

Talent.Name: Improvised Detonation
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to perform the Improvised Detonation action and build an explosive device, dealing damage equal to ranks in Intellect + ranks in Mechanics + [SU].

Talent.Name: Improvised Detonation (Improved)
Talent.Description: Reduce the difficulty of Improvised Detonation to [B]Average ([DI][DI]) [b]and increase damage to twice ranks in Mechanics.

Talent.Name: Loom
Talent.Description: When an ally engaged with the character makes a successful Charm, Deception, or Negotiation check, the character adds [AD] per rank in Coercion to the ally's check.

Talent.Name: Rain of Death
Talent.Description: Perform the Rain of Death maneuver to ignore the increased difficulty due to the Auto-fire quality of attacks made this turn.

Talent.Name: Steady Nerves
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Steady Nerves from Cool or Skulduggery checks.

Talent.Name: Talk the Talk
Talent.Description: When making a Knowledge skill check, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to substitute Knowledge (Underworld) or Streetwise for the required skill.

Talent.Name: Walk the Walk
Talent.Description: The character may spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage equal to his ranks in Streetwise to one hit of a successful Brawl check.

Talent.Name: Idealist
Talent.Description: Spend 1 stain to add an [AD] on a skill check.

Talent.Name: Against All Odds
Talent.Description: When incapacitated, perform Against All Odds action, making [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b] with [FO] equal to Force rating. Heal wounds equal to [SU], spend [FP] to add [SU].

Talent.Name: Animal Bond
Talent.Description: Develop long-term bond with single animal of silhouette no greater than half Force rating rounded down.

Talent.Name: Animal Bond (Improved)
Talent.Description: When spending a maneuver to direct a bonded animal, the character may suffer 1 strain to add [BO] to the animals next check.

Talent.Name: Animal Empathy
Talent.Description: When making checks to handle or tame animals, add [FO] no greater than Force rating to the check. Spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the check.

Talent.Name: Body Guard (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, when an ally protected by the Body Guard maneuver suffers a hit, suffer the hit instead.

Talent.Name: Body Guard (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Body Guard maneuver may protect a number of engaged characters up to ranks in Resilience.

Talent.Name: Calming Aura
Talent.Description: When an opponent targets character with a Force power, reduce [FP] generated by 1.

Talent.Name: Calming Aura (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend a maneuver and suffer 2 strain to extend Calming Aura's effects to allies equal to Willpower at short range until start of next turn.

Talent.Name: Center of Being
Talent.Description: Take a Center of Being maneuver. Until the beginning of next turn, attacks against the character increase their critical rating by 1 per rank of Center of Being.

Talent.Name: Center of Being (Improved)
Talent.Description: Suffer 1 strain to perform Center of Being maneuver as an incidental.

Talent.Name: Circle of Shelter
Talent.Description: When an engaged ally suffers a hit, may use Parry or Reflect incidental against the hit.

Talent.Name: Comprehend Technology
Talent.Description: Take Comprehend Technology action; make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] to use Force rating as ranks in skills to use a single item.

Talent.Name: Conditioned
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Conditioned from Athletics and Coordination check. Reduce the damage and strain suffered from falling by 1 per rank of Conditioned.

Talent.Name: Contingency Plan
Talent.Description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to recover strain equal to Cunning rating.

Talent.Name: Counterstrike
Talent.Description: When an attack misses the character and generates [DE] or [TH][TH], may upgrade next [B]Lightsaber (Cunning) check[b] against attacker during encounter once.

Talent.Name: Defensive Circle
Talent.Description: May take the Defensive Circle action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Lightsaber (Intellect) check[b]. The character, plus one ally within short range per [SU], gains X defense until the beginning of next turn. X equals 1, plus 1 per [AD][AD].

Talent.Name: Defensive Training
Talent.Description: When wielding a Lightsaber, Melee, or Brawl weapon, the weapon gains the Defensive quality with a rating equal to ranks in Defensive Training.

Talent.Name: Disruptive Strike
Talent.Description: Perform Disruptive Strike action; make a [B]Lightsaber (Cunning) combat check[b], adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add [FA] to the next combat check the target makes.

Talent.Name: Djem So Deflection
Talent.Description: After using Reflect, may spend 1 Destiny Point to perform Move maneuver as out-of-turn incidental to close distance with or engage opponent.

Talent.Name: Draw Closer
Talent.Description: Perform Draw Closer action; make a [B]Lightsaber (Willpower) combat check[b] against one silhouette 1 target within medium range, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating to check. Spend [FP] to move target one range band closer or to add [SU] to check.

Talent.Name: Duelist's Training
Talent.Description: Add [BO] to their Melee and Lightsaber checks when engaged with only one opponent.

Talent.Name: Enhanced Leader
Talent.Description: When making a Leadership check, add [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the result.

Talent.Name: Falling Avalanche
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to add damage equal to Brawn to next Lightsaber combat check made that turn.

Talent.Name: Feint
Talent.Description: Spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] generated on a missed Lightsaber, Melee, or Brawl attack to upgrade difficulty of opponent's next attack targeting character by ranks in Feint.

Talent.Name: Force Assault
Talent.Description: Spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] on a missed [B]Lightsaber (Willpower) combat check[b] to immediately perform Move Force power action as maneuver.

Talent.Name: Force Protection
Talent.Description: Perform the Force Protection maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to ranks of Force Protection. Increase soak by number of [FO] committed until beginning of next turn. Suffer 1 strain every turn [FO] remains committed.

Talent.Name: Forewarning
Talent.Description: Perform the Forewarning action. All allies within medium range increase defense by character's Force rating until they act in the encounter.

Talent.Name: Hawk Bat Swoop
Talent.Description: Take the Hawk Bat Swoop action. Perform a [B]Lightsaber (Agility) combat check[b] against target within short range, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to engage target and spend [FP] to add [AD] to check.

Talent.Name: Healing Trance
Talent.Description: Commit [FO]. For every full encounter [FO] remains committed, heal 1 wound per rank of Healing Trance.

Talent.Name: Healing Trance (Improved)
Talent.Description: When healing wounds due to Healing Trance, make a Resilience check to heal a Critical Injury. Difficulty of the check equals severity of the Critical Injury.

Talent.Name: Imbue Item
Talent.Description: Take the Imbue Item maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] to grant one weapon, piece of armor, or item an improvement while [FO] remains committed. Suffer 1 strain every round [FO] remains committed.

Talent.Name: Intuitive Evasion
Talent.Description: Perform the Intuitive Evasion maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to ranks of Intuitive Evasion. Upgrade difficulty of combat checks targeting starship or vehicle by equal amount. Suffer 1 strain every round [FO] remains committed.

Talent.Name: Intuitive Improvements
Talent.Description: When making check to craft or repair item, may add [FO] no greater than Force rating to check. Spend [FP][FP] to increase hard points by 1, to max of +2.

Talent.Name: Intuitive Shot
Talent.Description: When making a Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) combat check, add [FO] no greater than Force rating to the check. May spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD].

Talent.Name: Intuitive Strike
Talent.Description: When making a combat check with a planetary scale weapon, add [FO] no greater than Force rating to the check. Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU] or [AD].

Talent.Name: Keen Eyed
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Keen Eyed from Perception and Vigilance checks. Decrease time to search a specific area by half.

Talent.Name: Knowledge is Power
Talent.Description: Once per session, when making a check count Force rating as being equal to ranks in Knowledge (Lore).

Talent.Name: Knowledgeable Healing
Talent.Description: When healing an ally, spend 1 Destiny Point to heal additional wounds equal to ranks in Knowledge (Xenology).

Talent.Name: Makashi Flourish
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, perform Makashi Flourish action. Make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Lightsaber (Presence) check[b]. 1 engaged opponent suffers strain equal to [SU], and heal an equal amount of strain.

Talent.Name: Master Artisan
Talent.Description: Once per round, may take the Master Artisan Incidental; suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of next Mechanics check by 1, to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].

Talent.Name: Mental Bond
Talent.Description: May perform the Mental Bond action. Commit [FO]. While committed, may communicate with bonded animal at long range and see and hear through its senses.

Talent.Name: Mental Tools
Talent.Description: Always count as having the right tools for the job when performing Mechanics checks.

Talent.Name: Multiple Opponents
Talent.Description: Add [BO] to Brawl and Melee checks when engaged with multiple opponents.

Talent.Name: Natural Blademaster
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Melee check.

Talent.Name: Natural Mystic
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Force power check.

Talent.Name: Now You See Me
Talent.Description: Once per session, take Now You See Me action. Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to make a number of NPC's equal to Cunning within medium range forget about character.

Talent.Name: One With The Universe
Talent.Description: Once per session, mediate, then perform One with the Universe action; make [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Astrogation check[b]. If successful, add [LI] to all Force power checks in next encounter. If successful with [TH], add [DA] instead.

Talent.Name: Parry
Talent.Description: When hit by a melee attack, suffer 3 strain to reduce damage by 2 plus ranks in Parry.

Talent.Name: Parry (Improved)
Talent.Description: When parrying a hit that generate [DE] or [TH][TH][TH], may hit attacker once with Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber weapon (dealing base damage) after original attack resolves.

Talent.Name: Parry (Supreme)
Talent.Description: If the user did not make a combat check during his previous turn, may suffer 1 strain to use Parry.

Talent.Name: Physician
Talent.Description: When making a Medicine check to help a character heal wounds, the target heals 1 additional strain per rank of Physician.

Talent.Name: Preemptive Avoidance
Talent.Description: May spend 1 Destiny Point to disengage from engaged enemy as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Prey on the Weak
Talent.Description: Add +1 damage to one hit of successful combat checks against disoriented targets per rank of Prey on the Weak.

Talent.Name: Quick Movement
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to perform the Quick Movement incidental; add [FO] no greater than Force rating to next check. May spend [FP][FP] to perform one additional Move maneuver after action.

Talent.Name: Reflect
Talent.Description: When hit by a ranged attack, suffer 3 strain to reduce damage by 2 plus ranks in Reflect.

Talent.Name: Reflect (Improved)
Talent.Description: When reflecting a hit that generated [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] may hit one target in medium range with the same damage as the initial hit, after original attack resolves.

Talent.Name: Reflect (Supreme)
Talent.Description: If the user did not make a combat check during previous turn, may suffer 1 strain to use Reflect.

Talent.Name: Resist Disarm
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to avoid being disarmed or have weapon damaged or destroyed.

Talent.Name: Saber Swarm
Talent.Description: Perform the Saber Swarm maneuver; suffer 1 strain to make next Lightsaber (Agility) combat check this turn gain the Linked item quality equal to Force rating during check.

Talent.Name: Saber Throw
Talent.Description: Perform Saber Throw action; make Lightsaber combat check as a ranged attack at target within medium range, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Must spend [FP] and succeed to hit target; spend [FP] to have weapon return to hand.

Talent.Name: Sarlacc Sweep
Talent.Description: Increase difficulty of Lightsaber check by 1 to perform Sarlacc Sweep action. May spend [AD][AD] to hit additional engaged targets.

Talent.Name: Sense Advantage
Talent.Description: Once per session, may add [SE][SE] to 1 NPC's skill check.

Talent.Name: Share Pain
Talent.Description: May perform the Share Pain incidental when bonded animal suffers wounds. Reduce wounds suffered to half, then character suffers wounds equal to number reduced.

Talent.Name: Shroud
Talent.Description: The character may spend 1 Destiny Point to make himself undetectable via Force powers and make his own powers go unnoticed for the remainder of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Slippery Minded
Talent.Description: If under the effects of a Force power, perform the Slippery Minded action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to immediately end effects of power.

Talent.Name: Strategic Form
Talent.Description: May take the Strategic Form action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Lightsaber check[b] rolling [FO] no greater than Force rating. If successful, 1 target within short range may only attack character for 1 round. Spend [FP] to extend effects for 1 target for 1 round.

Talent.Name: Sum Djem
Talent.Description: May spend [TR] or [AD][AD] with a successful Lightsaber check to disarm opponent.

Talent.Name: Terrify
Talent.Description: Take the Terrify action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b], adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Disorient one target within medium range per [SU]. Spend [AD][AD] to extend duration and spend [FP] to immobilize affected target.

Talent.Name: Terrify (Improved)
Talent.Description: Reduce the difficulty of Terrify's check to [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b] and may spend [TR] to stagger an affected target.

Talent.Name: The Force Is My Ally
Talent.Description: Once per session, may suffer 2 strain to perform Force power action as maneuver.

Talent.Name: Unity Assault
Talent.Description: If a missed combat check generates [TR] or [AD][AD][AD], may spend to perform Force power targeting allies as a maneuver.

Talent.Name: Valuable Facts
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, perform a Valuable Facts action: make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge check[b] (the GM and player should determine which Knowledge skill is most applicable in the given situation). If successful, add [TR] to one ally's skill check during the encounter.

Talent.Name: Bad Cop
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD] from a Deception or Coercion check to upgrade ability of a single ally's subsequent Social Interaction check against the target a number of times equal to ranks in Bad Cop.

Talent.Name: Biggest Fan
Talent.Description: Once per session, may take a Biggest Fan action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b] to turn one NPC into the character's biggest fan.

Talent.Name: Congenial
Talent.Description: May suffer a number of strain to downgrade difficulty of Charm or Negotiation checks or upgrade difficulty when target by Charm or Negotiation checks, by an equal number Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Congenial.

Talent.Name: Coordination Dodge
Talent.Description: When targeted by a combat check, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [FA] equal to ranks in Coordination to check.

Talent.Name: Distracting Behavior
Talent.Description: Make a Distracting Behavior maneuver and suffer strain no greater than ranks in Cunning. Until the beginning of next turn, equal number of NPC's suffer [TH] on checks. Range increases with additional ranks.

Talent.Name: Distracting Behavior (Improved)
Talent.Description: The Distracting Behavior maneuver inflicts [TH][TH] on NPC's checks when NPC's target character's allies.

Talent.Name: Deceptive Taunt
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make Deceptive Taunt action. Make opposed Deception check. If successful, one adversary must attack the character during adversary's next turn.

Talent.Name: Good Cop
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD] from a Charm or Negotiation check to upgrade ability of a single ally's subsequent Social Interaction check against the target a number of times equal to ranks in Good Cop.

Talent.Name: Natural Athlete
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Athletics or Coordination check.

Talent.Name: Natural Merchant
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Streetwise or Negotiation check.

Talent.Name: Throwing Credits
Talent.Description: At beginning of session, spend 100 credits to ignore strain threshold penalty due to triggered Obligation.

Talent.Name: Unrelenting Skeptic
Talent.Description: When targeted by a Deception check, the character automatically adds [FA] to the check equal to ranks in Vigilance.

Talent.Name: Unrelenting Skeptic (Improved)
Talent.Description: When targeted by a Deception check that fails, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [DE] to results.

Talent.Name: Beast Wrangler
Talent.Description: Add [BO] per rank of Beast Wrangler to checks to tame or wrangle creatures.

Talent.Name: Bolstered Armor
Talent.Description: Increase the armor value of Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Bolstered Armor.

Talent.Name: Corellian Sendoff
Talent.Description: Take a Corellian Sendoff action targeting two ships or vehicles at Close range; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check[b] to cause the targets to suffer a minor collision.

Talent.Name: Corellian Sendoff (Improved)
Talent.Description: When performing a Corellian Sendoff, the targets suffer a major collision instead.

Talent.Name: Customized Cooling Unit
Talent.Description: Increase the system strain threshold of Signature Vehicle by 2 per rank of Customized Cooling Unit.

Talent.Name: Expert Handler
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Expert Handler from Survival checks made to ride beasts.

Talent.Name: Fancy Paint Job
Talent.Description: Upgrade all Charm, Deception, and Negotiation checks made in the presence of Signature Vehicle once.

Talent.Name: Fortified Vacuum Seal
Talent.Description: Increase the hull trauma threshold of Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Fortified Vacuum Seal.

Talent.Name: High-G Training
Talent.Description: When a starship or vehicle being piloted would suffer system strain, may suffer strain up to ranks in High-G Training to prevent an equal amount of system strain.

Talent.Name: Koiogran Turn
Talent.Description: When an opponent has gained the advantage on a starship or vehicle being piloted, may perform a Koiogran Turn maneuver to remove the effects.

Talent.Name: Larger Project
Talent.Description: Signature Vehicle can have a silhouette 1 larger per rank of Larger Project.

Talent.Name: Not Today
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to save Signature Vehicle from destruction.

Talent.Name: Overstocked Ammo
Talent.Description: Increase the value of the Limited Ammo quality of any weapons mounted on Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Overstocked Ammo.

Talent.Name: Reinforced Frame
Talent.Description: Signature Vehicle gains Massive 1: when making an attack targeting the ship or vehicle, the Critical rating of any weapon used counts as 1 higher.

Talent.Name: Showboat
Talent.Description: When making a check in a starship or vehicle, may suffer 2 strain to gain [TR] on success or [DE] on failure.

Talent.Name: Soothing Tone
Talent.Description: Take a Soothing Tone action; make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check[b] to allow a beast to recover strain equal to [SU].

Talent.Name: Spur
Talent.Description: Take a Spur action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to increase a beast's top speed by 1. The beast suffers 2 strain every round it stays spurred.

Talent.Name: Spur (Improved)
Talent.Description: Suffer 1 strain to attempt Spur as a maneuver and decrease its difficult to [B]Average ([DI][DI]).[b]

Talent.Name: Spur (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When activating and maintaining Spur, the beast only suffers 1 strain instead of 2.

Talent.Name: Tuned Maneuvering Thrusters
Talent.Description: Increase the handling of Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Tuned Maneuvering Thrusters.

Talent.Name: Call 'Em
Talent.Description: Do not add [SE] to combat checks due to the use of the Aim maneuver.

Talent.Name: Disarming Smile
Talent.Description: Take the Disarming Smile action; succeed at an opposed Charm check to lower all defenses of a target by ranks in Disarming Smile until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Don't Shoot!
Talent.Description: Once per session as an action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b]. On a success, cannot be target of combat checks until the end of the encounter or until making a combat check.

Talent.Name: Double or Nothing
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to perform the Double or Nothing incidental to increase the difficulty of the next check by one. Then, after canceling opposing symbols, double the amount of remaining [AD]

Talent.Name: Double or Nothing (Improved)
Talent.Description: When performing the Double or Nothing incidental, after canceling opposing symbols, also double the amount of remaining [SU].

Talent.Name: Double or Nothing (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When performing the Double or Nothing incidental, also double the number of [TR] and [DE].

Talent.Name: Fortune Favors the Bold
Talent.Description: Once per session as an incidental, suffer 2 strain to flip one dark side Destiny Point to light side.

Talent.Name: Guns Blazing
Talent.Description: As an incidental, suffer 2 Strain to avoid increasing the difficulty of a Ranged (Light) check to attack with two weapons.

Talent.Name: Just Kidding!
Talent.Description: Once per round as an incidental spend 1 Destiny Point to ignore [DE] generated on a social check by the character or any ally in short range.

Talent.Name: Quick Draw (Improved)
Talent.Description: May use Quick Draw twice per round.

Talent.Name: Second Chances
Talent.Description: Once per encounter choose a number of positive dice equal to ranks in Second Changes and reroll them.

Talent.Name: Sorry About the Mess
Talent.Description: Decrease the Critical Rating of a weapon by 1 (to a minimum of 1) against targets that have not yet acted this encounter.

Talent.Name: Spitfire
Talent.Description: After a successful combined check with two Ranged (Light) weapons, additional hits can be allocated to other targets within range of the weapon.

Talent.Name: Up the Ante
Talent.Description: When gambling win 10% more credits per rank of Up the Ante.

Talent.Name: Bad Press
Talent.Description: Once per session, choose an organization and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b]. On success, organization members have their wound thresholds reduced by 1, plus 1 per [SU][SU][SU], until the end of the session.

Talent.Name: Blackmail
Talent.Description: When an NPC exceeds his strain threshold, may spend 1 Destiny Point to convince that NPC to perform a single task of choice instead.

Talent.Name: Cutting Question
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when making a Coercion skill check, the character may use Deception skill instead.

Talent.Name: Discredit
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, take the Discredit action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to upgrade the difficulty of one character's social checks once, plus once for every [AD][AD], until of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Encoded Communique
Talent.Description: Upgrade the difficulty of checks to decrypt this character's coded messages without the proper cipher a number of times equal to Computers skill.

Talent.Name: Encouraging Words
Talent.Description: After an engaged ally fails a check, may suffer 1 strain to assist that ally's next check this encounter as an out of turn incidental.

Talent.Name: In The Know
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] up to ranks in In the Know from checks to get information from people or disseminate news. Minion NPCs do not realize this character's allegiance in interviews.

Talent.Name: In The Know (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, make an [B]opposed Deception vs Vigilance[b] check with the difficulty downgraded once per rank of In the Know to have a target NPC believe specific false intelligence.

Talent.Name: Informant
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reveal a contact who can shed light on a chosen subject.

Talent.Name: Interjection
Talent.Description: After another character makes a social check, suffer 3 strain to take an interjection incidental make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] to add [SU] or [FA] equal to [SU], and [AD] or [TH] equal to [AD] to the check.

Talent.Name: Know-It-All
Talent.Description: Once per session, perfectly recall an important fact previously learned as if a Destiny Point had been spent.

Talent.Name: Plausible Deniability (Improved)
Talent.Description: Take an Improved Plausible Deniability action makes a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b] to convince one bystander per rank of Plausible Deniability to depart quietly.

Talent.Name: Positive Spin
Talent.Description: Whenever any character's Duty would increase, it increases by an additional 1 per rank of Positive Spin.

Talent.Name: Positive Spin (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, if no PC's Duty triggered, make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b] with the difficulty decreased once rank of Positive Spin to have one PC's Duty trigger.

Talent.Name: Researcher (Improved)
Talent.Description: On a successful Knowledge check, character and allies gain automatic [AD] per rank of Researcher on checks to act on those facts until the end of his next turn.

Talent.Name: Supporting Evidence
Talent.Description: When assisting an ally with a Charm, Deception, Leadership, or Negotiation check, add automatic [AD] per rank of Supporting Evidence.

Talent.Name: Thorough Assessment
Talent.Description: Once per session, take a Thorough Assessment action: make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge check[b] (the GM and player should determine which Knowledge skill is most applicable in the given situation) to gain Boost dice equal to [SU] that can be distributed during the encounter. They cannot allocate more than one boost die to any single check this way. At the end of the encounter, any unused boost dice are lost.

Talent.Name: Twisted Words
Talent.Description: When an incoming social check generates [TH][TH] or [DE], may suffer 1 strain as an incidental to inflict strain equal to ranks in Coercion on speaker.

Talent.Name: Drive Back
Talent.Description: The Inquisitor may spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] on a missed Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber combat check to force target to make a move maneuver in a direction of the Inquisitor's choice.

Talent.Name: Armor Master (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per round, when the character suffers a Critical Injury, he may suffer 3 strain to take the Armor Master incidental. If he does he reduces the Critical Injury result that he suffers by 10 per point of his soak, to a minimum of 1.

Talent.Name: Baleful Gaze
Talent.Description: When targeted by combat check from within medium range, may spend a Destiny Point to upgrade the difficulty of the check a number of times equal to ranks in Coercion.

Talent.Name: Blind Spot
Talent.Description: The character and allies within short range add automatic [AD] to combat checks they make while benefiting from cover.

Talent.Name: Grapple
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may perform the Grapple maneuver. Until the beginning of the character's next turn, enemies must spend two maneuvers instead of one maneuver to move from engaged range to short range of him.

Talent.Name: No Escape
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD] from a Coercion check or [TH][TH] from a foe's Discipline check; that target cannot perform a free maneuver during his next turn.

Talent.Name: Overbalance
Talent.Description: Whenever an enemy engaged with the character makes a combat check, after the attack is resolved, the character may spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] to stagger the attacker until the end of the attacker's next turn.

Talent.Name: Precision Strike
Talent.Description: When this character inflicts a Critical Injury with a Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber weapon, may suffer 1 strain to change the result to any [B]Easy ([DI])[b] Critical Injury result.

Talent.Name: Prime Positions
Talent.Description: When this character or an ally in short range takes cover, he increases soak against ranged attacks by 1 per rank of Prime Positions until he leaves that cover.

Talent.Name: Prescient Shot
Talent.Description: Add [BO] to all Ranged (Light) checks unless the target is immune to Force powers.

Talent.Name: Prophetic Aim
Talent.Description: While benefiting from an Aim maneuver, [DE] from the character's Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) checks cannot cause attacks to hit allies engaged with the target.

Talent.Name: Reinforce Item
Talent.Description: Take the Reinforce Item maneuver: commit [LI][LI] to grant one weapon or piece of armor the Cortosis quality while [LI][LI] remains committed. Suffer 3 strain every round [LI][LI] remain committed.

Talent.Name: Suppressing Fire
Talent.Description: The character and each ally within short range may spend [AD] on their failed combat checks to inflict one strain on the target per rank of Suppressing Fire. Each character can only activate this effect once per round.

Talent.Name: Calm Commander
Talent.Description: May use ranks in Cool to upgrade Mass Combat checks instead of ranks in Leadership.

Talent.Name: Clever Commander
Talent.Description: May use ranks in Knowledge (Warfare) to upgrade Mass Combat checks instead of ranks in Leadership.

Talent.Name: Commanding Presence (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, may take Commanding Presence action; make an opposed [B]Cool vs. Discipline[b] check to force target to leave the encounter.

Talent.Name: Confidence (Improved)
Talent.Description: My spend [TR] on a fear check to steady the nerves of other allies making the same fear check. If the character does so, each ally within short range who makes the fear check adds automatic [SU] equal to the character's ranks in Confidence to the results of the check.

Talent.Name: Master Instructor
Talent.Description: Once per round as an out of turn incidental, may suffer 2 strain to allow ally to use character's ranks in Discipline for next Discipline check an ally makes.

Talent.Name: Master Strategist
Talent.Description: Once per phase during a mass combat, may suffer 2 strain to decrease difficulty of a Mass Combat check once.

Talent.Name: Natural Instructor
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll one Discipline or Leadership check.

Talent.Name: Ready for Anything
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Ready for Anything on Mass Combat checks and Cool or Vigilance checks to determine Initiative order.

Talent.Name: Ready for Anything (Improved)
Talent.Description: When making Cool or Vigilance checks to determine Initiative order, may spend [TR] to add [SU] equal to ranks in Ready for Anything.

Talent.Name: That's How It's Done
Talent.Description: May suffer 1 strain on successful skill check to add [AD] to the same skill check made by a number of allies equal to Willpower within short range during the next round.

Talent.Name: Well Read
Talent.Description: Choose any 3 Knowledge skills. They permanently become career skills.

Talent.Name: Custom Loadout
Talent.Description: May add 2 additional hard points to Signature Vehicles.

Talent.Name: Cyberneticist
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Cyberneticist from checks to build, repair, and install cybernetic implants . Cybernetics cost 50% less.

Talent.Name: Deft Maker
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Deft Maker from checks to repair, modify, construct, or program droids. Reduce the material cost to craft droids by 50%.

Talent.Name: Engineered Redundancies
Talent.Description: Gain the ability to use emergency repair patches to heal. Additionally, can be healed with Mechanics checks.

Talent.Name: Eye for Detail
Talent.Description: After making a Mechanics or Computers check, may suffer strain up to ranks in Eye for Detail to convert that many [SU] to [AD].

Talent.Name: Energy Transfer
Talent.Description: May suffer 1 strain to use the Energy Transfer maneuver to power up an unpowered device or replenish exhausted ammunition for an energy weapon.

Talent.Name: Machine Mender
Talent.Description: When making a Mechanics check to help a character heal wounds, the target heals 1 additional wound per rank of Machine Mender.

Talent.Name: More Machine Than Man
Talent.Description: Increase cybernetic implant cap by 1 per rank of More Machine than Man.

Talent.Name: Overcharge
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may use the Overcharge action. Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b]. On success one installed cybernetic provides additional benefits. On [DE], overcharged cybernetic shorts out.

Talent.Name: Overcharge (Improved)
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from Overcharge action to immediately take another action.

Talent.Name: Overcharge (Supreme)
Talent.Description: May perform the Overcharge action on any number of installed cybernetics. On [DE], one overcharged cybernetic shorts out.

Talent.Name: Reroute Processors
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may take a Reroute Processors action, make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Computers check[b] to reduce one of a droid's characteristics by 1 and increase another of its characteristics by 1.

Talent.Name: Resourceful Refit
Talent.Description: May perform the Resourceful Refit action, make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to scavenge an old attachment to construct a new one, reducing its price by that of the dismantled attachment.

Talent.Name: Speaks Binary (Improved)
Talent.Description: When directing NPC droids, those droids grand additional [BO] in addition to other benefits.

Talent.Name: Speaks Binary (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may perform the Speaks Binary maneuver. A number of NPC droids up to ranks in Speaks Binary may use the character's ranks for 1 skill of character's choice.

Talent.Name: Deathblow
Talent.Description: After making a successful attack with a non-starship/vehicle weapon, the character may spend one Destiny Point to add damage equal to his Willpower to one hit of the successful attack.

Talent.Name: Essential Kill
Talent.Description: When making a non-Gunnery combat check, the character may add [FO] no greater than his Force rating to the check. The character may spend [FP] to add [AD] or [FP][FP][FP] to add [TR] (character's choice) to the result.

Talent.Name: Force Connection
Talent.Description: When the character performs a Survival or Knowledge (Xenology) skill check, he may roll [FO] no greater than his Force rating. The character may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] (character's choice) to the result.

Talent.Name: Harass
Talent.Description: Whenever the character's bonded animal makes a successful combat check against a target, it may forgo inflicting damage to upgrade the difficulty of the target's next check once instead.

Talent.Name: Holistic Navigation
Talent.Description: When making an Astrogation skill check, the character may spend one Destiny Point to remove [DE], or to remove [TH] equal to his ranks in Perception.

Talent.Name: Intuitive Navigation
Talent.Description: When performing an Astrogation or Knowledge (Outer Rim) skill check, the character may roll [FO] no greater than his Force rating. The character may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] (character's choice) to the result.

Talent.Name: Marked for Death
Talent.Description: Take the Marked for Death maneuver; committing [FO]. Add [AD][AD] to combat checks against target while [FO] remains committed but cannot use this talent again until the original target is incapacitated or the session ends.

Talent.Name: Menace
Talent.Description: Enemy within short range of the character's bonded animal adds [SE] to next Combat check made against the character.

Talent.Name: Mind Over Matter
Talent.Description: The character may spend one Destiny Point to recover strain equal to to his Willpower rating.

Talent.Name: One with Nature
Talent.Description: When in the wilderness, the character may make a [B]Simple (-) Survival check[b] instead of Discipline or Cool to recover strain at the end of an encounter.

Talent.Name: Planet Mapper
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Planet Mapper from Streetwise or Survival checks used for navigation on a world. Such checks also take half normal time.

Talent.Name: Shortcut (Improved)
Talent.Description: When engaging in a chase or race, may suffer 2 strain to add [SU] equal to ranks in Shortcut to the check.

Talent.Name: Studious Plotting
Talent.Description: When making a Streetwise or Survival skill check to navigate on a world, the character may use Intellect instead of Cunning.

Talent.Name: Survival of the Fittest
Talent.Description: Once per session, when making a single check the character may treat his Force rating as being equal to ranks in Survival.

Talent.Name: Terrifying Kill
Talent.Description: The character may spend one Destiny Point to perform a Terrifying Kill maneuver immediately after conducting a successful attack where the target is incapacitated or suffers a Critical Injury (the character must still be able to perform maneuvers, and may not perform more than two maneuvers in a turn). The character rolls Force dice no greater than [their] Force rating, and may spend a Force point to inflict 1 strain on any characters within short range of that target (and may do so multiple times).

Talent.Name: Ambush
Talent.Description: Once per round while benefiting from cover, may make the Ambush maneuver. Add damage equal to Stealth skill to one hit of next successful combat check against a target within short range before the end of the turn.

Talent.Name: Cunning Snare
Talent.Description: Once per encounter as an action, may create a trap. Any other character who moves to engaged range of the trap must make an [B]Opposed Vigilance vs. Survival check[b] to avoid harm and ill effects.

Talent.Name: Moving Target
Talent.Description: If the character has already acted this round, increase ranged defense by 1 per rank of moving target.

Talent.Name: Seize the Initiative
Talent.Description: Once per session, as a maneuver, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Athletics check[b]. On success, other PCs may take their turns immediately. Each PC who acts this way counts as having acted for this round (and thus cannot act again this round. The Initiative order returns to its previous order at the beginning of the next round.

Talent.Name: Domesticable
Talent.Description: Downgrade the difficulty of checks to train this mount by 1 per rank.

Talent.Name: Trained Mount
Talent.Description: Add [BO] per rank to a rider's Survival checks while mounted on this mount.

Talent.Name: Beast of Burden
Talent.Description: Add 1 per rank to the mount's encumbrance threshold.

Talent.Name: Stubborn
Talent.Description: Upgrade the difficulty of checks to train this mount by 1 per rank.

Talent.Name: Domesticated
Talent.Description: Difficulty for training this beast is not upgraded.

Talent.Name: Flyer
Talent.Description: This mount can fly. When on the ground, its Speed is reduced to 1.

Talent.Name: Better Luck Next Time
Talent.Description: Take a Better Luck Next Time action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check[b] to force a competitor to suffer a major misfortune.

Talent.Name: Constant Vigilance
Talent.Description: May always use Vigilance when making checks to determine initiative.

Talent.Name: Fear the Shadows
Talent.Description: Perform the Fear the Shadows action: make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to force a single minion group or rival to flee the encounter.

Talent.Name: Freerunning
Talent.Description: Suffer 1 strain when making a Move maneuver to move to any location within short range.

Talent.Name: Freerunning (Improved)
Talent.Description: Suffer 4 strain when making a move maneuver to move to any location within medium range.

Talent.Name: Impossible Fall
Talent.Description: Once per session, perform Impossible Fall incidental when falling: make Force power check and spend [FP][FP] to decrease fall by one range band and land somewhere safe. Spend [FP] to decrease distance by one additional range band.

Talent.Name: Reconstruct the Scene
Talent.Description: Perform the Reconstruct the Scene action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b] to identify the physical characteristics of person present at the scene within 24 hours.

Talent.Name: Saber Throw (Improved)
Talent.Description: When performing the Saber Throw action, may increase the range to long range. When attacking a target at long range, spend [FP][FP] to have weapon return to hand.

Talent.Name: Sense the Scene
Talent.Description: Perform the Sense the Scene action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b] and add [FO] no greater than Force rating. If successful, spend [FP] to identify the emotional characteristics of one person involved in the crime.

Talent.Name: Street Smarts (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, may take an Improved Street Smarts action; make a [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise[b] or [B]Knowledge (Underworld) check[b] to learn one vital clue from the GM. Reduce the difficulty once per rank of Street Smarts.

Talent.Name: Superhuman Reflexes
Talent.Description: Once per session, after generating [DE] on a Piloting check cancel the [DE] and add [SU] equal to ranks in Cool.

Talent.Name: Hard-Boiled
Talent.Description: When recovering strain after an encounter, may spend [AD] up to ranks in Hard-Boiled to recover 1 wound per [AD] spent.

Talent.Name: Hindering Shot
Talent.Description: Increase the difficulty of next Gunnery check by 1. If check deals damage, target starship or vehicle suffers system strain equal to speed when it moves until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Iron Body
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Iron Body from Coordination and Resilience checks. Reduce the critical rating of unarmed attacks by 1 per rank of Iron Body (to a minimum of 1).

Talent.Name: Martial Grace
Talent.Description: Once per round, suffers 2 strain to add damage equal to ranks in Coordination to next Brawl check made this turn.

Talent.Name: Offensive Driving
Talent.Description: As a maneuver, suffer system strain up to vehicle's highest defense to upgrade the difficulty of target's next Piloting check that many times.

Talent.Name: Precision Strike (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per round, when inflicting a Critical Injury with a Brawl or Melee weapon, may suffer 2 strain to change the result to any [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b] Critical injury.

Talent.Name: Precision Strike (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per game session, when the character inflicts a Critical Injury with an unarmed attack, they may suffer 3 strain to change the result to any [B]Hard difficulty ([DI][DI][DI])[b] Critical Injury. Combat checks to activate this talent cannot be made with any weapons.

Talent.Name: Unarmed Parry
Talent.Description: May Parry while unarmed Reduce strain cost to Parry while unarmed by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

Talent.Name: Aggressive Negotiations
Talent.Description: Once per session perform a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Lightsaber check[b] to decrease the difficulty of all Negotiation checks for the rest of the encounter by 2.

Talent.Name: Crucial Point
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may introduce to negotiations and one potential concession that an opponent will do nearly anything to obtain.

Talent.Name: Empty Soul
Talent.Description: If the character is carrying items that total 2 encumbrance or less add [LI][DA] to Force power checks.

Talent.Name: Go Without
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character counts as having the right tools for the job when making a skill check.

Talent.Name: Iron Soul
Talent.Description: When carrying items that total 2 encumbrance or less, at the end of each encounter heal all strain the character is suffering.

Talent.Name: Meditative Trance
Talent.Description: When suffocating (see [B]Force and Destiny[b] Core Rulebook, page 221), the character suffers 1 strain each round instead of 3. When exposed to vacuum, the character suffers 1 wound each round instead of 3.

Talent.Name: Mind Bleed
Talent.Description: When attacked, the character may choose to suffer strain no greater than the number of wounds suffered from the attack. If he does so, the attacker then suffers a number of wounds equal to the strain suffered by the character.

Talent.Name: Now the Master
Talent.Description: Once per session, choose one talent or Force power that any character in the current encounter possesses. Gain that talent or Force power until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Once A Learner
Talent.Description: As an action, suffer 4 strain and let one ally within short range increase the ally's Force rating by an amount equal to the character's Force rating until the end of the round.

Talent.Name: Savvy Negotiator
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Savvy Negotiator from all Negotiation and Streetwise checks.

Talent.Name: Savvy Negotiator (Improved)
Talent.Description: Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Negotiation check[b] to convince one bystander per rank of Savvy Negotiator to see one of an opponent's points as maliciously unreasonable.

Talent.Name: Skilled Teacher
Talent.Description: If an ally at short range has lower ranks in a skill than the character, the character may perform a Skilled Teacher incidental to suffer a number of strain no greater than ranks of Skilled Teacher, then add an equal number of [SU] to ally's next check.

Talent.Name: Sunder (Improved)
Talent.Description: Each [AD] spent to activate a weapon's Sunder quality damages an item two steps, instead of one.

Talent.Name: Wise Warrior
Talent.Description: When making a combat check, may perform the Wise Warrior incidental; spend 1 Destiny Point and use any characteristic for the check.

Talent.Name: Wise Warrior (Improved)
Talent.Description: When performing the Wise Warrior incidental, one ally at short range may use the same characteristic for the next combat check the ally makes before the end of the character's next turn.

Talent.Name: Combat Programming
Talent.Description: Once per encounter make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers check[b] while repairing or working on a droid. For the remainder of the encounter, the droid gains 1 rank in two different combat skills.

Talent.Name: Construction Specialist
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] equal to ranks in Construction Specialist from checks to construct defenses, positions, fortifications, and similar projects.

Talent.Name: Creative Design
Talent.Description: As part of resolving a successful crafting check, the character may also apply a result equivalent to spending a number of [AD] equal to his ranks in Creative Design. The GM may then apply a result equivalent to spending that same number of [TH].

Talent.Name: Desperate Repairs
Talent.Description: Once per session may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] on one engaged allied droid. If successful, the droid becomes immobilized and staggered for 1 round, then heals all strain and one Critical Injury with a severity rating no greater than [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI])[b].

Talent.Name: Design Flaw
Talent.Description: When making a combat check with a personal scale weapon against a droid, may add [AD] equal to ranks of Design Flaw.

Talent.Name: Dockyard Expertise
Talent.Description: May make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] when at a space dock, if successful, the cost and time for repairs is reduced by 25% per rank of Dockyard Expertise.

Talent.Name: Improvised Defenses
Talent.Description: May make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to fashion small defenses. It providing cover for up to 4 characters for the rest of encounter.

Talent.Name: Improvised Position
Talent.Description: The character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to construct a secure position. This provides cover for the group and its vehicles.

Talent.Name: Master Demolitionist
Talent.Description: When resolving an attack from a personal explosive or ordnance weapon, may spend [AD] or [TR] to have the weapon's Blast quality act at short range, or medium if it already acts at short.

Talent.Name: Push the Specs
Talent.Description: Perform the Push the Specs action when in a starship or vehicle, making an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b]. With success, the ship's top speed increases by 1 for a number of rounds equal to the characters Intellect.

Talent.Name: Repair Patch Specialization
Talent.Description: Whenever using an emergency repair patch, the target heals an additional wound per rank of Repair Patch Specialization.

Talent.Name: Smart Handling
Talent.Description: Once per session, take the Smart Handling action; making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b]. Until the start of the next round the ship's handling increases by 2 plus an amount equal to [AD] scored on the check to a maximum handling of +4.

Talent.Name: Weak Foundation
Talent.Description: Once per session may take the Weak Foundation action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Warfare) check[b], if successful, for the remainder of the encounter the character and all allies add automatic [AD][AD] or [SU] to all combat checks made targeting the identified fixed structure.

Talent.Name: Alchemical Arts
Talent.Description: After making a crafting check to create a potion or talisman, the character may choose to suffer strain no greater than twice their ranks in Alchemical Arts. For every two strain, they may add [LI] or [DA] to the results. If they choose to add [DA], they also suffer 1 Conflict per [DA].

Talent.Name: Channel Agony
Talent.Description: After rolling [FO], may suffer wounds up to twice ranks in Channel Agony to add automatic [DA] for every two wounds suffered to the results.

Talent.Name: Font of Power
Talent.Description: Once per game session, the character may perform the Font of Power action. For the remainder of the encounter, if the character is a light side Force user, whenever another Force user within medium range rolls [FO], add automatic [LI] to the results. If the character is a dark Side Force user, whenever another Force user within medium range rolls [FO], add automatic [DA] to the results.

Talent.Name: Identify Ingredients
Talent.Description: After being exposed to a substance, as an out-of-turn incidental, may roll [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP][FP] to immediately identify its composition and effects.

Talent.Name: Overwhelming Aura
Talent.Description: Commit [FO]. Add [AD] to social checks equal to [FO] committed. Add [TH] to equal [FO] committed to enemy social checks in short range.

Talent.Name: Overwhelming Aura (Improved)
Talent.Description: Characters affected by Overwhelming Aura add automatic [FA] to fear checks the character causes and automatic [SU] to fear checks not caused by the character.

Talent.Name: Power of Darkness
Talent.Description: Once per session, may perform the Power of Darkness maneuver. Increase wound threshold and strain threshold by 1 per Dark Side Destiny point currently in the Destiny pool until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Transmogrify
Talent.Description: When making a crafting check, may add [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add [SU] and spend [FP][FP] to add [AD] to check.

Talent.Name: Acklay's Scything Strike
Talent.Description: The character's Brawl attacks gain the Pierce quality with a rating equal to their Force rating, or increase their existing Pierce quality by that amount.

Talent.Name: Dodge (Improved)
Talent.Description: After using Dodge, can make a Move maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Embrace Your Hate
Talent.Description: May spend 1 Destiny Point and suffer Conflict equal to dark side Destiny Points in pool to add equal damage to Brawl, Lightsaber, or Melee attack. May use this ability once per encounter per rank.

Talent.Name: Far Strike
Talent.Description: As an action, make a Brawl check as a ranged attack, adding [FO] up to Force rating, increase the range of the attack by one band for each [FP] spent, to a maximum of long.

Talent.Name: Headbutt
Talent.Description: Perform Headbutt incidental, suffering 2 wounds to knock down and disorient enemy.

Talent.Name: Indomitable Will
Talent.Description: Once per encounter as a maneuver, suffer 3 strain to commit [FO] up to Force rating and reduce all damage suffered by an equal amount, but suffer 1 strain per turn.

Talent.Name: Inner Peace
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, convert a number of dark side Destiny Points equal to ranks in Inner Peace to light side Destiny Points and reduce Conflict gained this session.

Talent.Name: Juyo Savagery
Talent.Description: The character adds +5 to Critical injury rolls from Lightsaber attacks for each dark side Destiny Point in the Destiny pool.

Talent.Name: Power From Pain
Talent.Description: Once per session as an incidental, may spend 1 Destiny Point to gain +1 Force rating for each Critical Injury character is suffering until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Sapith Sundering
Talent.Description: May add [FO] up to Force rating to Brawl checks; the attack gains the Sunder quality, and character may spend [FP] generated one the check as [AD] to activate the Sunder quality.

Talent.Name: Toughened (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, may heal wounds equal to ranks in Toughened.

Talent.Name: Vaapad Control
Talent.Description: When making a Lightsaber combat check, the character may suffer 1 strain to downgrade the difficulty of this check a number of times equal to the number of light side Destiny Points in the Destiny pool.

Talent.Name: A Step Ahead
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may suffer 2 strain in order to count his Cunning as one higher than normal for the remainder of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Analyze Data
Talent.Description: Once per session after capturing enemy data, the character may perform the Analyze Data action to make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Warfare) check[b]. Once during the remainder of session he may then add [SU] equal to ranks in Knowledge (Warfare) to one check related to that data.

Talent.Name: Cunning Persona
Talent.Description: The character may suffer 2 strain to make a Charm check with Cunning instead of Presence.

Talent.Name: Exhaustive Questioning
Talent.Description: Whenever a character makes a successful social skill check against a captured enemy within short range, may reduce that enemy’s strain threshold by 2 for the remainder of the session and can spend [AD] to inflict 1 strain.

Talent.Name: Hidden Storage (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may use Hidden Storage to store an item within his own suitably modified body (such as through cybernetics, surgery, or prosthetic replacements).

Talent.Name: Incite Distraction
Talent.Description: While in a crowd, may perform the Incite Distraction action to make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Deception check[b]. If successful, enemies treat the area as difficult terrain. The character may spend [TR] to make the location impassable terrain to them instead.

Talent.Name: Indistinguishable (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may extend the effects of Indistinguishable to a number of allied within short range equal to ranks in Deception.

Talent.Name: Inside Knowledge
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may perform the Inside Knowledge action to make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b] while within an enemy facility or vessel. He can then find a single personal scale weapon or device he previously stashed here with a rarity no greater than his Cunning plus 2. Alternatively, he can gain a narrative benefit such as knowing the codes to open sealed doors, the location of the commander's office, personality quirks or weaknesses amongst personnel, which security cameras have been deactivated or broken, secret or concealed rooms, or some other equivalent type of information.

Talent.Name: Inside Person
Talent.Description: Once per session the character may spend a Destiny Point to establish he has been undercover in an identified enemy base or large vehicle. For the remainder of the session, add automatic [AD][AD] to checks he or his allies make that are associated with that location.

Talent.Name: Know Their Weakness
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may choose one target within short range and perform the Know Their Weakness action to make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b]. If successful, the character downgrades the difficulty of social skill checks he makes against that target once per rank of Know Their Weakness.

Talent.Name: Know Their Weakness (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may extend the effects of Know Their Weakness to a number of enemy characters within short range equal to his rating of Presence.

Talent.Name: Lose Them
Talent.Description: When being followed or chased, the character may perform the Lose Them action and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Stealth check[b]. If successful, add [SE][SE] to checks to follow him for the remainder of the encounter and may spend [TR] to indicate his pursuers have lost him completely.

Talent.Name: Made You Talk
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make an opposed social skill check against a captured enemy character within short range and add [BO] for every 2 strain inflicted on the target that encounter. If successful, the PCs gain a bonus based on the enemy NPC type.

Talent.Name: Pilot Training
Talent.Description: Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space) become career skills.

Talent.Name: Resist Questioning
Talent.Description: When targeted by an opposed social skill check, the character may suffer 2 strain to perform the Resist Questioning out-of-turn incidental, adding [SE] to the check. If the check fails, may spend [DE] to indicate he has provided false information to foe.

Talent.Name: Resist Questioning (Improved)
Talent.Description: When one ally within short range is targeted by an opposed social skill check, the character may perform Resist Questioning to affect this check instead. If the check fails, may spend [DE] to indicate the ally provided false information to foe.

Talent.Name: Adaptable
Talent.Description: When resolving a check that uses a skill in which they nave no ranks, the character may spend one Destiny Point to remove [DE] from the check or to remove [TH] equal to their ranks in Cool from the check.

Talent.Name: Another's Treasure
Talent.Description: The condition of an item does not affect the price the character receives when selling it. In addition, the character can always find a buyer for an item, no matter its condition or how useless or worthless it may seem. The details of the transaction are subject to the GM’s discretion, as always, and a buyer might not be immediately (or easily) available.

Talent.Name: Assault Drop
Talent.Description: Once per session while piloting a vehicle or ship, the character may perform the Assault Drop incidental. All passengers aboard or allies engaged with the vehicle or ship may immediately disembark or embark as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Backroom Deal
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may take the Backroom Deal action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Negotiation check.[b] If the check succeeds the character (or player) reveals how their previously unknown dealings have a meaningful impact on the current scene or encounter. The nature of the revelation and its impact on the scene are ultimately subject to the GM's discretion, but they should give a significant advantage to the PCs. If the check fails and generates [DE], however, the GM may decide that the character's disastrously failed deal has negative repercussions.

Talent.Name: Barrel Roll
Talent.Description: When a vehicle or starship the character is piloting suffers a hit from a combat check, after damage is calculated but before armor is applied, the character may take a Barrel Roll incidental. Their ship suffers 3 system strain, and the damage of that hit is reduced by an amount equal to their ranks in the Piloting skill used for that vehicle. This talent may only be used once per attack and only when the character is piloting a vehicle or starship of silhouette 3 or less.

Talent.Name: Barrel Roll (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character takes the Barrel Roll incidental, reduce the damage of all hits (instead of only one hit) of the attack by the character's ranks in the relevant Piloting skill.

Talent.Name: Barrel Roll (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When the character uses Barrel Roll to reduce the damage from a weapon with the Auto-fire, Blast, or Guided item qualities, they may spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] to inflict one hit on the attacker or another enemy vehicle or starship within close range after the initial attack resolves. The hit deals the base damage of the original attack.

Talent.Name: Beginner's Luck
Talent.Description: Once per session when the character makes a check , the character may add [SU] equal to the number of light side Destiny Points in the Destiny pool to the results.

Talent.Name: Clanker Killer
Talent.Description: Before rolling a combat check that targets a droid (including a droid vehicle or a vehicle piloted by a droid), the character may remove [BO] up to their ranks in Clanker Killer from the pool, and add an equal number of [SU] or [AD] (in any combination) to the results.

Talent.Name: Consider Our Options
Talent.Description: The character may take the Consider Our Options action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Negotiation check.[b] If the check succeeds, until the start of the character's next turn, any enemy who attacks the character suffers 2 strain, plus 1 strain per additional [SU][SU] on the character's check, before resolving the attack. (If this strain causes an adversary to become incapacitated, the GM may determine that adversary simply bows out of the fight.) The effect ends immediately if the character inflicts damage on an enemy.

Talent.Name: Consider Our Options (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character takes the Consider Our Options action, the character may choose to have the effects also apply to attacks that target the character’s allies who are within short range. The effects end for all characters if the character or an affected ally inflict damage on an enemy.

Talent.Name: Exceed Specifications
Talent.Description: Before making a check using an item, the character may take the Exceed Specifications incidental, adding [BO] to the check. The GM may spend [TH][TH] on the check to damage the item one step, or [DE] to damage it beyond usability (see [B]Table 5-4: Repairing Gear[b] in any core rulebook). [TH] or [DE] may have additional consequences depending on the nature of the item, at the GM's discretion.

Talent.Name: Exceed Specifications (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character takes the Exceed Specifications incidental, upgrade the ability of the check once instead of adding [BO].

Talent.Name: Exceed Specifications (Supreme)
Talent.Description: If the character's check benefitting from the Exceed Specifications incidental generates [TR], they may damage the item one step to roll one additional [PR] and add it to the check results. If the check generates [DE] roll [CH] and add it to the check results.

Talent.Name: Fire Support
Talent.Description: After the character makes a successful combat check using a vehicle weapon, the next ally to make a check adds [BO] equal to the character's ranks of Fire Support.

Talent.Name: Fire When Ready
Talent.Description: The character may take the Fire When Ready action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check.[b] If the check succeeds, the character chooses a number of crew aboard their ship equal to their Presence. Those crew members downgrade the difficulty of their next Gunnery check once, plus one time for every additional [SU][SU] on the check.

Talent.Name: First Among Brothers
Talent.Description: When the character makes a check that does not result in any uncanceled [TH], add [AD] equal to the character's ranks in First Among Brothers to the check results. The character may only spend these additional [AD] to affect allied clones.

Talent.Name: For the Republic!
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when an ally is incapacitated or killed, the character may perform the For the Republic! incidental. The character makes a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check.[b] If the check succeeds, the ally is not incapacitated or killed until the end of the following round, instead. If the character's wounds or strain are reduced below their threshold before the end of the next round, they are not incapacitated.

Talent.Name: Guardian of the Republic
Talent.Description: After the character uses Parry or Reflect to reduce damage to an ally, that ally cannot be targeted by combat checks for the remainder of the round.

Talent.Name: Hyperspace Assault
Talent.Description: The character may use Astrogation or Knowledge (Warfare) to determine their Initiative during an encounter in which they are piloting or commanding a starship. If they do so, they may spend [TR] from the check to choose the starting locations of all allied ships in the encounter.

Talent.Name: Lateral Thinking
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after an enemy succeeds on a check targeting the character, the character may spend one Destiny Point to force the enemy to reroll the check. If the enemy is a droid, the character does not spend a Destiny Point to use this talent.

Talent.Name: Learning Opportunity
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may spend [AD][AD][AD] from a check they fail to upgrade the ability of their next check once.

Talent.Name: Leverage
Talent.Description: The character removes [SE] per rank of Leverage from their Cool and Negotiation checks.

Talent.Name: Mission Critical
Talent.Description: Once per session after rolling a Piloting (Planetary) or Piloting (Space) check but before resolving it, the character may spend a Destiny Point to add [SU] or [AD] to the results equal to their ranks in that skill. (The character may divide the results between [SU] and [AD] In any combination.)

Talent.Name: Natural Operator
Talent.Description: Once per game session, the character may reroll any one Piloting (Planetary) or Piloting (Space) check.

Talent.Name: Natural Trooper
Talent.Description: Once per game session, the character may reroll any one Gunnery or Ranged (Heavy) check.

Talent.Name: One Person's Trash
Talent.Description: The character may make a Perception check in order to locate a particular item amid a battlefield, shipwreck, junkyard, or other location with potential salvage. The difficulty of the check is equal to half the item's rarity, rounded down. There is no cost to acquire an item this way, but the item is in need of Moderate repairs (see [B]Table 5-4: Repairing Gear[b] in any of the core rulebooks) when found.

Talent.Name: On My Order
Talent.Description: The character may take the On My Order action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership Check.[b] If the check succeeds, the character chooses a number of crew aboard their ship equal to their Presence. Those crew members upgrade the ability of their next Gunnery check once, plus one time for every additional [SU][SU] on the check.

Talent.Name: Ordnance Saturation
Talent.Description: When the character or an ally who is currently benefiting from On My Order or Fire When Ready activates the Blast quality of a planetary-scale weapon, all ships or vehicles within close range of the target suffer damage equal to the weapon's Blast quality (plus 1 per additional [SU] as usual).

Talent.Name: Outmaneuver
Talent.Description: The character may take the Outmaneuver action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Warfare) check.[b] If the check succeeds, the character chooses one enemy ship or vehicle in the current encounter for each [SU]. Until the end of the character's next turn, the chosen ships must perform one extra maneuver in order to move or change range bands relative to the characters ship or allies.

Talent.Name: Ravage
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may suffer 3 strain to add [FO] up to their current Force rating to a combat check targeting an engaged opponent. The character may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results of the check. If the rules for Morality in [B]Force and Destiny[b] are in use, a character who has purchased this talent gains 1 Conflict at the beginning of each game session.

Talent.Name: Respected Delegate
Talent.Description: The character downgrades the difficulty of social skill checks made to interact with government institutions outside of their homeworld a number of times equal to their ranks in Respected Delegate.

Talent.Name: Scrap 'Em!
Talent.Description: After making a successful combat check, the character may suffer 2 strain to perform the Scrap 'em! incidental. The character selects a number of allies no greater than their ranks in Leadership. Those allies Add [BO] to their combat checks against the character's target until the start of the character's next turn.

Talent.Name: Scrap 'Em! (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character takes the Scrap 'em! incidental, they affect a number of allies no greater than twice their ranks In Leadership, and affected allies add [BO][BO] to combat checks (instead of [BO]).

Talent.Name: Secrets of the Force
Talent.Description: Knowledge (Lore) and Lightsaber become career skills for the character.

Talent.Name: Side by Side
Talent.Description: While the character is wielding a lightsaber and engaged with one or more allies also wielding a lightsaber, add [TH] to all combat checks that target the character or those allies. (If multiple allied characters in the engagement possess this talent, the effects are cumulative.)

Talent.Name: Sincerest Flattery
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when the character makes a check using a skill that another character has previously used during the encounter, they add [BO][BO].

Talent.Name: Something to Prove
Talent.Description: Once per session the character may suffer 4 strain in order to reroll a failed check. If the check succeeds, the character heals 4 strain.

Talent.Name: Tactical Advance
Talent.Description: While in cover, the character may suffer 2 strain to perform the Tactical Advance incidental. Until the end of the character's next turn, the character and allies within short range may move out of cover and continue to receive its benefits.

Talent.Name: Tactical Advance (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may spend [AD][AD] from any check they make or [TH][TH] from a combat check targeting them to perform the Tactical Advance incidental (instead of suffering strain).

Talent.Name: Temple Training
Talent.Description: Before making a Lightsaber skill check, the character may spend one Destiny Point to add damage to the attack equal to his ranks in Knowledge (Lore).

Talent.Name: Translation Error
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may remove [DE] from the results of a social skill check they make.

Talent.Name: Utility Belt (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session when the character performs a Utility Belt incidental, they may produce up to five functionally identical items.

Talent.Name: Will of the Force
Talent.Description: Once per round after failing a skill check, the character may convert one dark Side Destiny Point to a light side Destiny Point.

Talent.Name: Combat Veteran
Talent.Description: The character adds [BO] to his Brawl and Discipline checks equal to his ranks in Combat Veteran.

Talent.Name: Cruel Commander
Talent.Description: When upgrading the ability of a Mass Combat check in a mass combat in which the character is the commander of the acting force (or when upgrading the difficulty, if the character is the commander of the enemy force), the character may use ranks in Coercion instead of ranks in Leadership.

Talent.Name: Droid Commander
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform Field Commander as a maneuver instead of an action. All affected allies must be droids.

Talent.Name: Exemplar of the Republic
Talent.Description: When making a Mass Combat check for which the character is the acting commander or takes a prominent role on the battlefield, the character may add [FO] no greater than their Force rating to the check. The character may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] (character's choice) to the result.

Talent.Name: Ichor Reserve
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may suffer 2 strain to perform the Ichor Reserve maneuver. Their Force rating increases by 1 until the end of the scene or encounter. At the GM's discretion, the character may need to occasionally return to Dathomir to replenish their supply of magickal ichor.

Talent.Name: Known Programming
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] to upgrade the difficulty of a certain droid model's check against the character, plus one ally per [SU] after the first, once for the rest of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Known Programming (Improved)
Talent.Description: Allies affected by Known Programming also upgrade the ability of their checks targeting the chose droid model once.

Talent.Name: Knowledge is Strength
Talent.Description: Once per session, when making a check, the character may increase their Force rating by their ranks in Knowledge (Warfare) for the duration of the check. If the rules for Morality in [B]Force and Destiny[b] are in use, a character who has purchased this talent gains 1 Conflict at the beginning of each game session.

Talent.Name: Lead From the Back
Talent.Description: Once per round when an enemy makes a successful combat check targeting the character, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to perform the Lead from the Back incidental. The character chooses one allied NPC subordinate within short range, who becomes the target of the attack instead. At the GM's discretion, the character may select an allied NPC at a greater distance if they are between the character and the attacker.

Talent.Name: Lead From the Front
Talent.Description: After succeeding on a Leadership check or other check to inspire, lead, or rally an audience, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to upgrade the ability of the next combat check made by each ally within short range once.

Talent.Name: Natural Champion
Talent.Description: Once per game session, the character may reroll any one Leadership or Lightsaber check.

Talent.Name: Nobody's Fool (Improved)
Talent.Description: When targeted by a Charm, Coercion, or Deception check, the character may spend [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] from the check to inflict strain on the opponent equal to the character's ranks in Nobody's Fool.

Talent.Name: Tactical Planning
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may substitute a Knowledge(Warfare) skill check for another skill check.

Talent.Name: Altered Deal
Talent.Description: Once per Session, the character may take the Altered Deal action and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b] to radically change a previously agreed upon deal or bargain to a version much more advantageous to the character. The player player must narratively explain what happened, including the details of how the character arranged for the deal to be changed as well as the specifics of the new deal.

Talent.Name: As the Force Wills It
Talent.Description: May make an [B]Easy ([DI]) Knowledge (Lore) check[b] to heal strain at the end of an encounter. [TR] can be spent to heal all strain.

Talent.Name: By the Book
Talent.Description: Once per encounter before making a combat check, the character may suffer two strain to add [AD] to the results equal to his ranks in By the Book.

Talent.Name: Comrades in Arms
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may take a Comrades in Arms action to make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Discipline check[b]. If successful, the character plus one ally per [SU] within medium range gains +1 defense for the remainder of the encounter. Should an ally move outside of medium range, that ally loses this benefit.

Talent.Name: Cunning Stunt
Talent.Description: Use Cunning instead of Presence for Cool checks.

Talent.Name: Disciple of Lore
Talent.Description: Once per round, may suffer 1 strain to decrease the difficulty of next Knowledge (Lore) check a number of times equal to ranks in Disciple of Lore.

Talent.Name: Disciplined Soul
