Talent.Description: The character may spend one Destiny Point after making a Discipline check to spend a number of [TH] not exceeding the character's ranks in Knowledge (Lore) as [AD].

Talent.Name: Disorienting Strike
Talent.Description: After failing a Lightsaber combat check, may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to disorient opponents for three rounds.

Talent.Name: Double-Talk
Talent.Description: The character may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from a successful Charm or Deception check to disorient a number of opponents within short range equal to his Presence for remainder of round and next two rounds.

Talent.Name: Extended Reach
Talent.Description: While armed with a two-handed melee weapon, may suffer one strain to make a Melee combat check with that weapon targeting an enemy at up to short range (rather than engaged range).

Talent.Name: Fearsome Rep
Talent.Description: Add automatic [AD] to the results of Coercion checks equal to ranks in Fearsome Rep.

Talent.Name: Finesse
Talent.Description: Use Agility instead of Brawn for Brawl or Melee checks.

Talent.Name: Comrades in Arms (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from Comrades in Arms check to also gain +1 soak or give one affected ally +1 soak.

Talent.Name: Secrets of the Jedi (Improved)
Talent.Description: Discipline becomes a career skill. Secrets of the Jedi may also be used when installing mods on melee weapons.

Talent.Name: Know the Enemy
Talent.Description: The character may use Knowledge (Warfare) skill when making checks to determine Initiative.

Talent.Name: Knows the Ropes
Talent.Description: Add [BO] to checks made to escape from restraints equal to ranks in Knowledge (Underworld). Spend [TR] to free all other allies withing short range.

Talent.Name: Persistent Targeting
Talent.Description: After making one or more successful combat checks against a target, add [BO] to combat checks against that same target for the remainder of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Prepare to be Boarded!
Talent.Description: Once per encounter may take Prepare to be Boarded! action and make [B]opposed Coercion vs. Discipline check[b] against enemy ship captain. If successful, the enemy suffers 1 strain per uncanceled [SU] and surrenders ship if he exceeds strain threshold. May also spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD][AD] to inflict strain equal to ranks in Coercion.

Talent.Name: Push Aside
Talent.Description: After making a successful Melee, Brawl, or Lightsaber combat check against an engaged foe, may force the foe to move to short range in a direction of the opponent's choosing. Spend [TR] to cause the opponent to fall prone after moving.

Talent.Name: Seen A Lot of Things
Talent.Description: Whenever the character fails a Knowledge check, he may spend [AD][AD][AD] to roll the check again during his next turn.

Talent.Name: Steady Aim
Talent.Description: The character does not lose the benefits of the Aim maneuver if he performs other maneuvers (including moving) or actions. He does lose the benefits of the Aim maneuver if the encounter ends.

Talent.Name: Targeted Firepower
Talent.Description: Once per session may take Targeted Firepower action; identify one enemy target and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Warfare) check[b]. If successful, for the rest of the encounter allies within short range of character add [AD] to attacks against target equal to [SU] gained in the check.

Talent.Name: Tenacious
Talent.Description: Upgrade the number of advantages needed to score a critical hit against the target a number of times equal to his ranks in Tenacious. Also, reduce a Critical Injury result he suffers by 10 per rank of Tenacious

Talent.Name: Trust No One
Talent.Description: When targeted by a social check, may choose to suffer one strain to add automatic [FA] to the check. If the check fails with [DE], the character may immediately perform a maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Madcap Maintenance*
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll one check to repair or maintain. If the rerolled check succeeds, add [TR] to the next check made using the item. Otherwise, the item becomes damaged further.

Talent.Name: Ask Questions Later
Talent.Description: Once per encounter as an out-of-turn incidental, before the character or an ally makes a social check, add [AD], [SU], or [TR] to that check, determined by the strongest type of adversary defeated during the current encounter: [AD] for a minion, [SU] for a rival, [TR] for a nemesis.

Talent.Name: Shoot First
Talent.Description: Once per session when a foe would attack, spend a Destiny Point to make a Ranged (Light) attack against that foe before they act as an out-of-turn incidental. They are considered to have not yet acted this round.

Talent.Name: Guns Blazing (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per round after making a successful two-weapon Ranged (Light) attack, suffer 3 strain to assign an additional hit from either weapon to a target within range.

Talent.Name: Trick Shot
Talent.Description: The character removes [SE][SE] imposed on Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) checks due to their target's cover or from the aim maneuver. Additionally, the character may make Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks targeting foes for which they lack line of site, per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Dangerous Development*
Talent.Description: When making a check to improve or craft an item, may suffer 2 strain and upgrade the check once. On [SU], may add a single permanent improvement to the item.

Talent.Name: EUREKA!*
Talent.Description: Once per session, may spend strain equal to difficulty of a successful Intellect check to add a [TR] to that check.

Talent.Name: SME*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may spend 1 Destiny point to add [BO] [BO] [BO] to any check the character makes to which their personal experience is relevant.

Talent.Name: Reverse Engineering*
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may spend credits and make a [B]Knowledge (Education)[b] or [B]Mechanics check[b] to create an identical copy of a piece of personal gear the character has access to. The difficulty of this check is equal to half the rarity of the item, rounded down, and the time required is 2 hours times the difficulty. The credit cost of this process is equal to half of the item's base price.

Talent.Name: Synthesis*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check[b] to create a chemical equivalent to any medical supply or chemical compound with a rarity of Intellect + [SU] or lower. The character may spend [AD][AD] to create an additional unit per [AD][AD] spent.

Talent.Name: Technobabble*
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] to establish a fact that solves a current problem.

Talent.Name: Hidden Feature*
Talent.Description: Once per session as an incidental, while the character is aboard a vessel they created or are intimately familiar with, they may activate a previously unknown minor feature of the vessel as if a Destiny Point had been spent, per GM discretion. This feature lasts until the end of the encounter. At any future point, any character may reactivate this feature by spending a Destiny point.

Talent.Name: Overcharged Battery*
Talent.Description: Once per round while piloting or operating a starship, before the character or an ally makes a Gunnery check, may have the starship suffer 2 system strain to increase the damage of the attack by 2 or reduce the Critical Rating by 1 (minimum of 1).

Talent.Name: Against The Odds*
Talent.Description: Add [BO] per rank of Against The Odds to [B]Daunting[b] or harder checks.

Talent.Name: Let’s Make It Interesting*
Talent.Description: Once per session after making a successful check to wager or gamble, spend a Destiny Point to have a loser substitute or supplement a narrative or material reward of the character's choice, instead of only credits. The reward is per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Make Your Own Luck*
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool Check[b]. On success, allies equal to ranks of Cool may reroll 1 positive die on the next check they make, plus one additional die for every [SU][SU] past the first. Spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to allow one of those allies to reroll positive or negative instead.

Talent.Name: Reversal of Fortunes*
Talent.Description: Once per session, after the character makes a check resulting in [DE], spend 1 Destiny Point to cancel a [DE] result and add a [DE] to the next check made by an adversary in the scene. How the character turned their misfortune around is per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Raise The Stakes*
Talent.Description: Once per check, the character may suffer 2 strain to increase and upgrade the difficulty of their next check once. If successful, add [AD] equal to the final difficulty of the check to the results.

Talent.Name: Raise The Stakes (Improved)*
Talent.Description: Double the number of [TR] and [DE] results on checks affected by Raise The Stakes, regardless of Success.

Talent.Name: Kill With Kindness (Improved)*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Leadership check[b]. On success, a number of characters equal to the character's ranks of Kill With Kindness add [AD] or [TH] to checks they make this encounter, chosen separately for each character. Spend [TR] to double the number of [AD] or [TH] added this way.

Talent.Name: Happy to Help*
Talent.Description: When providing or accepting assistance, add [BO] to the check in addition to the normal effects of assistance.

Talent.Name: Happy to Help (Improved)*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when assisting or being assisted, may choose to have Happy To Help add [SU] to the check instead of [BO].

Talent.Name: Bypass Security (Improved)*
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from checks to unlock doors or disable a security device to add [BO] equal to ranks of Bypass Security to similar checks in the same system or location this session.

Talent.Name: Decoy*
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to produce a facsimile of an encumbrance 1 or smaller item in the scene. Any character attempting to determine that it is counterfeit must make an [B]opposed Perception vs. Skulduggery check[b].

Talent.Name: Dirty Tricks
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b] to add [SE] equal to [SU] to the next check made by a number of enemies equal to the character’s ranks of Cunning.

Talent.Name: Exit Strategy*
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] to notice a discreet path of egress. On success, add [BO] to all checks the character or allies with medium range make to leave the encounter. This includes attacks against characters who intentionally impede their escape.

Talent.Name: Fade Away*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when targeted by a combat check, spend a Destiny Point to add [SE] equal to the character's ranks in Stealth. If that attack fails, the character may not be targeted by attacks until the beginning of their next turn.

Talent.Name: Stakeout
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool[b] or [B]Skulduggery check[b] while surveilling a person or place. For the remainder of the session, add automatic [AD][AD] to checks they make that are associated with that location or person.

Talent.Name: Animal Companion
Talent.Description: Choose an animal no larger than Silhouette 2 to be an Animal Companion. Upgrade all checks made to soothe or heal them once. If the Animal Companion ever dies or becomes lost, the character may work with the Game Master to choose a new one and determine the bonding process to make them the character’s Animal Companion.

Talent.Name: Animal Companion (Improved)
Talent.Description: Animal Companion may now be no larger than Silhouette 3. Attacks targeting an Animal Companion treat their critical rating as 1 higher.

Talent.Name: Break Them In
Talent.Description: Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Athletics check[b] to train one or more animals, upgrading the difficulty by the Animal’s Willpower. On success, one animal gains Trained Mount 1 until the end of the session, plus 1 animal per additional [SU][SU].

Talent.Name: Master Rider
Talent.Description: Once per turn while mounted, may suffer 2 strain to perform a Survival Check or other mount-handling action as a maneuver.

Talent.Name: Ride Down
Talent.Description: While mounted, the mount’s Brawl attacks and any rider’s melee attacks deal additional damage equal to the speed of the mount.

Talent.Name: Trusty Companion
Talent.Description: Once per session when successfully attacked, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point and perform the Trusty Companion out-of-turn incidental to have an Animal Companion within medium range move to the character and become the target of the attack instead. Alternatively, once per session when an Animal Companion is successfully targeted by an attack and is within short range of the character, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to move to the Animal Companion and become the target of the attack instead.

Talent.Name: Wily Rider
Talent.Description: Count mounted animals as having a silhouette as 1 lower when being attacked. Minimum of 0.

Talent.Name: Wrangle
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may suffer strain up to ranks in Athletics and perform the Wrangle maneuver. An animal or foe within short range adds [SE] equal to strain suffered to their next action and treats their surroundings as difficult terrain until the character’s next turn. [TH][TH] from checks made by the wrangled foe while wrangled may be spent to knock the foe prone, and [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] may be spent to Immobilize them for rounds equal to the character's ranks of Athletics. The character must have rope or a similarly-functioning item or short-range melee weapon to perform the Wrangle maneuver.

Talent.Name: Attack Vector
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b] to identify a weak point in an enemy vehicle or structure. On success, aim maneuvers made to target it before the end of the character’s next turn add [SU] in addition to normal effects.

Talent.Name: Combined Arms
Talent.Description: Allied characters within short range of a vehicle piloted by the character treat their ranged defense as equal to the highest defense zone of that vehicle.

Talent.Name: Fire Support (Improved)
Talent.Description: After making a successful attack, may spend 1 Destiny Point to extend the benefit of Fire Support to all allies within planetary close range.

Talent.Name: One in a Million
Talent.Description: Once per session, when inflicting a critical hit, may suffer 3 strain to change the result to any [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI])[b] Critical Hit.

Talent.Name: Trigger Discipline
Talent.Description: When making a ranged attack, the character may suffer 2 strain to remove a number of [BO] up ranks of Discipline from the dice pool, adding [AD] to the pool for each removed this way.

Talent.Name: Sustained Fire
Talent.Description: When performing an Aim maneuver, if the character successfully attacked the target this or last round, upgrade the ability of that attack instead of the aim’s normal effects (cannot be used to target a specific item or part of the target).

Talent.Name: Master Missileer
Talent.Description: Before rolling a [B]Guided[b] attack, may suffer strain up to ranks of the weapon’s combat skill to upgrade the ability of the [B]Guided[b] roll that many times.

Talent.Name: Weapons Free
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, as a maneuver, may ignore a weapon’s [B]Slow-Firing[b] quality this turn and upgrade the difficulty of the next check using it equal to its ranks of [B]Slow-Firing[b].

Talent.Name: Manual Override
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while piloting a silhouette 4 or smaller starship or vehicle that has exceeded its system strain threshold, the character may make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Coordination check[b] to set the system strain to its threshold and set the vehicle's speed to the last speed it had before exceeding the threshold. The character may spend [AD][AD] to reduce the number that the craft’s system strain is set to by 1 for each [AD][AD] spent, and may spend [TR] to immediately take another action.

Talent.Name: Planned Maintenance System
Talent.Description: Repairs made to Signature Vehicle cost 25% less per rank of Planned Maintenance System, rounded down.

Talent.Name: Signature Vehicle (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per session, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [TR] to a check involving the Signature Vehicle as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Unauthorized Requisition
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Underworld) check[b] to establish ill-gotten munitions or equipment in their ship or base, with a cost no greater than 250 credits per rank of Knowledge (Society). The item(s) must be contraband or stolen.

Talent.Name: Corellian Slip (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from attacks targeting the character or an ally within close range benefitting from Evasive Maneuvers to inflict a hit on the attacker.

Talent.Name: Break Off
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when an allied vehicle within close range becomes the target of an attack, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] to become the target of the attack. The character may spend [AD][AD] to upgrade the difficulty of the attack once, and may spend [TR] to have the original defender of the attack Gain The Advantage on the attacker.

Talent.Name: Corellian Slip
Talent.Description: When the character performs the Evasive Maneuvers maneuver, a number of allied vehicles equal to ranks in Vigilance and within close range also gain the benefits of the maneuver. These allied vehicles maintain the benefits until they leave close range with the character or the character loses the benefits of Evasive Maneuvers.

Talent.Name: Match Speed
Talent.Description: Once per round when an ally within close range performs the Accelerate/Decelerate, Fly/Drive, or Punch it maneuver, may suffer 2 strain to perform the same maneuver to follow that ally as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Assassinate
Talent.Description: When inflicting a critical injury on a minion group, if undetected by them, may spend additional [AD] to remove an additional member per [AD] spent. A character is considered to be undetected by a foe if they aren’t aware of their general or specific location, and aren’t on alert to their presence, before the attack. A Game Master may determine that even when generally alerted, a character is still undetected until they either attack again or reveal themself visually.

Talent.Name: Assassinate (Improved)
Talent.Description: Before rolling a combat check while undetected by the target, suffer strain up to [BO] in pool to trade that many [BO] for that many [AD]. Assassinate may remove a Rival by spending [AD][AD][AD] or [TR]. Assassinate may affect Nemesis foes at Game Master discretion.

Talent.Name: From the Shadows
Talent.Description: While undetected by enemies, the character may use the Stealth Skill when making checks to determine initiative.

Talent.Name: No Witnesses
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, after incapacitating an enemy, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Stealth[b] check. On success, they are undetected as the attacker. May spend [AD] to move one range band per [AD] spent, and may spend [TR] to escape the scene completely.

Talent.Name: Precise Aim (Improved)
Talent.Description: When using Precise Aim, all non-Gunnery attacks made by the character this round have their Pierce rating increased by ranks in Precise Aim.

Talent.Name: The Perfect Crime
Talent.Description: Once per session may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b] to reveal how a previously unknown plan assists them in a crime or attack during this scene. The nature of the revelation is ultimately subject to the GM’s discretion, but they should give a significant advantage to the PCs. If the check fails and generates a [DE], however, the GM may decide that the character’s plan goes seriously awry.

Talent.Name: Always Prepared
Talent.Description: Once per session, as an incidental, produce a previously undocumented piece of personal equipment or weapon, with a rarity no greater than 4, as if a Destiny Point was spent. If producing a weapon, it also has the Limited Ammo 1 quality.

Talent.Name: Master of Arms
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics[b] check. On success, a weapon quality (excluding Breach, Concussive, and Linked) of a weapon within engaged range has its rating increased by 2 until the end of the encounter. The GM may spend [DE] to have an affected weapon malfunction at the end of the encounter; it is considered broken until the character spends six hours making an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to repair it.

Talent.Name: Master of Arms (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when using the Master of Arms action, spend [AD][AD] or a [TR] to immediately take an additional action.

Talent.Name: Master of Arms (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When making the Master of Arms action, the character may choose any number of additional weapons to increase an existing quality’s rating of each of those weapons by 2, and may choose a different quality for each affected weapon. If they do, upgrade the difficulty once for each chosen weapon beyond the first. Each of the chosen qualities cost one less [AD] to activate, to a minimum of 1. Qualities that do not have a rating, such as Auto-Fire, are not applicable for the reduction.

Talent.Name: Target Acquired
Talent.Description: Take the Target Acquired Action, make an [B]opposed Coercion check[b] against an adversary within Medium Range. On Success, immobilize that adversary until the end of the next round. Spend [AD][AD] to effect an additional foe within medium range. When spending [AD] to affect additional targets, the additional targets must be of an equal or lesser adversary tier.

Talent.Name: Target Acquired (Improved)
Talent.Description: When taking the Target Acquired Action, the character adds [BO] per status effect affecting the target. Spend [TR] generated on the check to Stagger an affected adversary. Disorient, Burn, Prone, Immobilized, Staggered, and suffering from Crippling Blow are all status effects, but this list is not exhaustive, and GMs should include other non-named effects.

Talent.Name: Eye of the Storm
Talent.Description: Perform the Eye of the Storm maneuver, suffer 1 strain, to make next Brawl attack this turn gain the [B]Blast[b] quality with a rating equal to ranks of Brawn plus ranks of Discipline. Blast triggered on this attack only affects foes.

Talent.Name: Martial Prowess
Talent.Description: When making a combat check, may suffer 2 strain to substitute Athletics for Melee, or Coordination for Ranged (Light or Heavy).

Talent.Name: Unarmed Parry (Improved)
Talent.Description: Whenever an enemy engaged with the character makes a combat check, after the attack is resolved, the character may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] results to disarm the attacker, and may gain control of the used weapon. If not equipping the weapon, it falls within short range at a location of the player's choice.

Talent.Name: Prepare for Turbulence
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation[b] check. On success, the character notices or navigates towards a moderate navigation hazard at close range. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] for a severe navigation hazard.

Talent.Name: Smooth Operator
Talent.Description: After making a successful Gunnery attack, spend a Destiny Point and suffer strain no greater than [SU] to convert that many [SU] to [AD].

Talent.Name: Relentless
Talent.Description: Suffer a number of strain to downgrade the difficulty of checks to chase, track, or tail a target by an equal number. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks of Relentless.

Talent.Name: Stakeout (Improved)
Talent.Description: When using the Stakeout action, may spend [AD] to extend this benefit to 1 ally per [AD] spent, and may spend [TR] to add [SU] to 1 ally's checks.

Talent.Name: Ultimatum
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may make an opposed [B]Negotiations vs. Cool[b] check to add [SU] to each check made to attack or subdue the target. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to affect an additional target.

Talent.Name: Crash Through
Talent.Description: When instigating a collision with another vehicle, add +10 for each point of Armor of the character’s vehicle to the other vehicle’s resulting critical hit.

Talent.Name: Expert Tracker (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make the Improved Expert Tracker action; Make a [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Survival[b] or [B]Perception[b] to find a minor item lost by a tracked target. Decrease the Difficulty once per rank of Expert Tracker. On a successful check, spend [TR] to find a Major item instead. An example of a minor item is like an identifying accessory or some material indicating previous location or mode of travel. Examples of Major items could be an item like a sentimental or “quest item” that the target may not want to leave the vicinity without recovering, or an item like a weapon that may inhibit their combat effectiveness due to having lost.

Talent.Name: Gatherer
Talent.Description: When foraging for food, water, or shelter, the character may choose to add [BO] or remove [SE] from the check per rank of Gatherer.

Talent.Name: Know Your Prey
Talent.Description: Once per encounter make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology)[b] check to add [SE][SE] to all checks that target or are opposed by the character for the remainder of this encounter. Spend [AD] to extend that benefit to one ally per [AD] spent, and [TR] to upgrade the difficulty of those checks once.

Talent.Name: The Land Provides
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check [b]to fashion a low-tech solution to a current problem using nearby forageable materials. This solution or object must be approved by the GM, who may impose negative qualities like Inferior or Limited Ammo, and functions until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Natural Camouflage
Talent.Description: When making a stealth check in natural environments, suffer two strain to substitute Survival for the required skill.

Talent.Name: Nowhere is Safe
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from a non-vehicle or starship attack to reduce the target’s defense by a number equal to ranks in Perception until the end of the character’s next turn

Talent.Name: Nowhere is Safe (Improved)
Talent.Description: After making a successful attack against a defenseless target, may suffer 3 strain to add [TR] to the check. A character is considered defenseless if they have no defense rating against the attack.

Talent.Name: Hired Help
Talent.Description: Once per Encounter, the character may take the Hired Help action; they make an [B]opposed Negotiation vs Discipline check[b] targeting a minion group or Rival within Medium range. On success, they work towards the character's goals until the end of the encounter. The character must pay a minion group whose services are bought this way 100 credits per minion in the group, or 500 credits for a Rival. The task they are directed to perform must not violate common sense, their core values, or be obviously suicidal. The Game Master ultimately has control of the NPC(s), and determines the bounds of their support.

Talent.Name: Hired Help (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may spend 1 Destiny Point to have engaged Hired Help take a successful hit on the character instead, or take responsibility for something the character did.

Talent.Name: Hired Help (Supreme)
Talent.Description: The Hired Help action may now target enemy Minions and Rivals. The credit price to target them is doubled.

Talent.Name: Greased Palms (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll a social check by paying credits equal to 100 times the difficulty of the check.

Talent.Name: Sound Investments (Improved)
Talent.Description: At the beginning of each session, may invest all Sound Investment credits and make a [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Core Worlds)[b] or [B]Knowledge (Underworld) check[b], decreased by ranks of Sound Investments, to gain a return on the investment. On [SUCCESS], gain 100 additional credits plus 10% of the initial investments for each [SUCCESS] past the first. On [FA], lose half of the initial investment. [TRIUMPH] may be spent to double the number of successes on a successful check, or recover 75% of initial investment on a failed check.

Talent.Name: Merciful Shot
Talent.Description: Before making a non-Gunnery ranged attack, may suffer 2 strain to inflict damage as strain instead of wounds. If using a weapon with the Stun Damage quality or using the Stun Setting, add [BO][BO].

Talent.Name: Merciful Shot (Improved)
Talent.Description: When inflicting damage from non-gunnery ranged attack as strain damage, may spend [AD] [AD] [AD] or [TR] to [I]Stagger[i] or [I]Immobilize[i] the target.

Talent.Name: Reach For the Sky
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion[b] or [B]Leadership check[b]. A number of characters equal to Willpower suffer 1 strain when they perform a maneuver this encounter. Spend [TR] to force a character to perform a move maneuver.

Talent.Name: Master Manipulator
Talent.Description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to perform a social check as a maneuver.

Talent.Name: Pulling Strings
Talent.Description: Once per Session, make an opposed Social check to compel the target to perform a minor favor this session. Add [TR] to one check associated with this favor.

Talent.Name: Skilled Orator
Talent.Description: Once per round, may spend [TR] from a social check to affect twice the number of targets, or have each target recover or suffer twice the number of strain.

Talent.Name: Well-Connected
Talent.Description: Once per Session, the character may reveal a contact who can provide access to a person, location, or resource. When the character does this, they must explain how they know this contact and what their connection is to the desired person, location, or resource. They should be open to helping the players, but the Game Master determines their potential cost, in credits, material, labor, informal promises of future favors, or formal Obligation.

Talent.Name: Authority On The Subject
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when a foe would make a check, may spend 1 Destiny Point to establish a fact and treat the check as opposed by the character’s most appropriate Knowledge Skill.

Talent.Name: Astute Observation (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, if an ally would fail a check, may spend 1 Destiny Point to roll a [B]Perception check[b] using the original difficulty, if successful, the ally's check succeeds with the same results as the Perception check.

Talent.Name: Quick Study
Talent.Description: When making a skill check with an unranked skill, may suffer a number of strain to add an equal number of [BO] to the check. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Quick Study.

Talent.Name: Unquestioned Authority
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] from Coercion and Leadership checks equal to ranks of Unquestioned Authority.

Talent.Name: Emergency Bulkheads
Talent.Description: Once per session, when the Flagship would suffer a critical hit, may take an Emergency Bulkhead incidental; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Education check[b] to stop the vessel from suffering the critical hit. If successful, the Command Ship does not suffer the Critical Hit and does not suffer any of its normal effects (but the attack that causes the critical hit still deals damage as normal).

Talent.Name: Flagship
Talent.Description: Choose one starship as their Flagship. Upgrade the ability of fear checks made by crew on the Flagship once

Talent.Name: Flagship (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character performs the assist maneuver aboard their Flagship, upgrade the ability of the check once, in addition to normal effects of assistance.

Talent.Name: Flank Speed!
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may perform the Flank Speed! maneuver. The Flagship may perform two pilot-only maneuvers this round and the following round.

Talent.Name: Port of Call
Talent.Description: The Flagship has a dockyard, station, or other location they call home. Add [SU][AD] to all checks made to repair or resupply the Flagship at the Port of Call. If the Port of Call is ever conquered or closed to the character, a new Port of Call may be selected by making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Core World), (Outer Rim), (Underworld)[b], or [B](Warfare) check[b], depending on the nature of the location, and must be properly equipped and prepared, the time required for which is determined by the GM.

Talent.Name: Reckless Reposition
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation check[b]. On success, before a foe begins their turn or makes an attack, the character may have their vessel suffer system strain equal to its silhouette to microjump away as an out-of-turn incidental. At the beginning of the character's next turn, they may jump again to return no closer than long range from the original location as an incidental. The game Master may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from the check to choose the final location of the vessel instead.

Talent.Name: Reckless Reposition (Improved)
Talent.Description: May spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from Reckless Reposition to allow a close-range allied ship to jump with them, which may choose to stay outside the fight, or return with them.

Talent.Name: Take A Few With Us
Talent.Description: When aboard the Flagship, Fire Discipline affects twice the number of attacks, and those attacks reduce their critical rating by 1, (minimum of 1). When the Flagship has suffered hull trauma greater than half of its threshold, attacks made by it gain Breach +1.

Talent.Name: Under The Radar
Talent.Description: While their vessel is in difficult terrain, or is otherwise able to be obscured from enemies, the character may take the Under the Radar action to reduce the emissions of theirs and allied vessels at close range. For rounds equal to the character's Intellect rating, the character's vessel and allied vessels within close range go undetected by foes unless a foe makes an [B]opposed Perception vs Computers (Sysops) check[b], adding [BO] to the check for each ally included. Any vessel that exceeds speed 1, attacks, or engages in excessive systems use ends this effect for that vessel.

Talent.Name: Ceasefire
Talent.Description: Once per session, when leading armed conflict or mass combat, may make an opposed [B]Negotiation vs Cool[b] check targeting the opposing leader. On success, the leaders in the conflict agree to pause hostilities. Add [DE] to first combat check made by an involved character until the end of the following round. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to extend the Ceasefire an additional round, and spend [TR] to exempt allied characters from the effect.

Talent.Name: Figure of War
Talent.Description: The Inspiring Figure incidental may be used to re-roll a failed Mass Combat check as if it were an ally's check. If a re-rolled Mass Combat check is successful, add [TR] to the check.

Talent.Name: Inspiring Figure
Talent.Description: Once per session, suffer 4 strain to allow an ally within medium range to reroll a failed check.

Talent.Name: Fight Through It!
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when an ally would exceed one of their thresholds, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b] to set their wounds or strain to 1 below its threshold.

Talent.Name: Return Fire!
Talent.Description: Once per round, when an enemy incapacitates or inflicts a critical injury upon an ally within short range, suffer 3 strain to inflict a hit on that enemy with an equipped weapon.

Talent.Name: Stern Mentor
Talent.Description: Once per Encounter, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b]. On success, allies equal to Willpower rating may suffer 2 strain and decrease the difficulty of their next check once.

Talent.Name: Attack Pattern Delta
Talent.Description: May make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Leadership check[b] to have other allied vehicles up to ranks of Leadership within close range benefit from the character's ranks of Defensive Driving.

Talent.Name: Wing Commander
Talent.Description: While piloting a starship or vehicle, the character and allies within close range may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from checks to determine initiative to perform a pilot-only maneuver as an out of turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Half The Battle
Talent.Description: Once per session, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [SE] equal to ranks of a Knowledge skill to any check. If that check fails, add [DE] to the results. The player must state the knowledge they possess which will be their adversary’s undoing.

Talent.Name: Thorough Assessment (Improved)
Talent.Description: When distributing a [BO] from Thorough Assessment, may choose to distribute a [SU] instead.

Talent.Name: Element of Surprise
Talent.Description: May spend [TR] from checks to determine initiative to force one enemy to use the last available initiative slot this encounter.

Talent.Name: Counteroffensive
Talent.Description: Once per round, may spend [TH][TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from a foe’s combat or Leadership check to make a Leadership Check as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Killzone
Talent.Description: Once per session when holding a defensible position, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b]. On success, foes within medium range add [TH] to all checks for rounds equal to ranks of Cunning.

Talent.Name: Killzone (Improved)
Talent.Description: The range of Killzone is extended to long range, and foes treat the area as difficult terrain. May spend[AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to add [FA] to all affected checks as well.

Talent.Name: Clear The Room
Talent.Description: Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion[b] or [B]Deception check[b] to convince bystanders equal to Willpower to depart quietly. If interrogated about the matter later, these NPCs deny having seen anything or have forgotten anything of importance. The Game Master may determine a minion group acts as a single character for the purposes of this talent.

Talent.Name: Kingmaker
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, an ally may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a social check to treat their rating in the associated characteristic as if it were 1 higher until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Read The Room
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b]. On success, gain social insight into one character per [SU], and spend [AD][AD] to add [BO] to all social checks made by you and allies targeting one of those characters. For each character, the player learns which social skill will be most effective against them, or which social skill they are most likely to employ, but not both.

Talent.Name: Set The Tone
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Negotiation check[b], and choose two social skills. Decrease the difficulty (minimum [B]Easy ([DI])[b]) of all checks made by others using the first and increase those using the second this encounter.

Talent.Name: I Have Friends Everywhere
Talent.Description: Once per session, may perform a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check[b]. On Success, the character chooses an NPC in the scene, or reveals a previously unknown NPC; that NPC is sympathetic to the character's cause and performs a favor for the character. This favor may be rebellious in nature and may result in legal scrutiny and consequence, but must not be obviously suicidal. The Game Master determines if an NPC cannot be considered sympathetic.

Talent.Name: Mask The Movement
Talent.Description: May make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to cover the character or allies’ involvement in a crime or dissident activity, adding [FA] plus [FA] for each [SU][SU] past the first to all checks to investigate the offense this session.

Talent.Name: Righteous Anger
Talent.Description: The character may suffer 2 strain to make a Leadership check with Willpower instead of Presence.

Talent.Name: Spark of Rebellion
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b] to cause a number of beings equal to ranks of Coercion plus Willpower to become rebellious until the end of the encounter, and may spend [AD][AD] to guide their general goal. This could be due to something the character did or said, or just because the beings were already unhappy with their position.

Talent.Name: Spark of Rebellion (Improved)
Talent.Description: Double the number of characters affected by Spark of Rebellion. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to affect all rebel-sympathetic characters instead.

Talent.Name: Tools of Rebellion
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Underworld)[b] or [B]Knowledge (Warfare) check[b]. On Success, an amount of weapons and equipment suitable to outfit allies equal to [SU] is covertly stashed nearby.

Talent.Name: A Call For Aid
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b]. On success, the character reveals how a previously unknown call for aid has a meaningful impact on the scene. If the check fails and generates a [DE] result, however, the GM may decide that the character's ineffective plea either puts them in further danger, or the intended ally is apprehended when answering the call.

Talent.Name: Escape Clause
Talent.Description: Once per session when under scrutiny by authorities, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Core Worlds) check[b] to cite law or regulation that exempts or exonerates them. This does not need to be a true reading of the letter or spirit of this law or ordinance, and the character does not need to actually cite regulations that exist, they simply must have a convincing enough command of legal statutes to dissuade their immediate detainment.

Talent.Name: For the Greater Good
Talent.Description: Once per session after being successfully attacked, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] to ignore the damage and the effect of this attack until the end of the encounter after which, the character suffers the damage, and the effects of any exceeded thresholds, status effects, or critical injuries, in that order.

Talent.Name: Respond In Kind
Talent.Description: May spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from an incoming social check to add [SU][AD] to the next Charm, Negotiation, or Leadership check the character or an ally makes targeting that adversary.

Talent.Name: Uniter of People
Talent.Description: Once per session, may choose a faction or group and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Negotiation check[b]. On success, allied characters and the chosen faction within medium range add [AD] to skill checks this encounter. The character may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to decrease the difficulty of all affected characters’ next check.

Talent.Name: Active Listener
Talent.Description: When targeted by an opposed social check, may suffer 2 strain to oppose the check with Perception (Cunning) instead of Cool or Discipline.

Talent.Name: Codebreaker (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, may choose a faction or group and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers check[b] to gain insight on their plans or communications. On success, may add [FA] equal to ranks of Codebreaker to one check made by that group this session.

Talent.Name: Active Listener (Improved)
Talent.Description: When using Active Listener, may also suffer strain up to ranks of Perception to add that many [SE] to the check.

Talent.Name: Heroic Embellishment
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may spend 1 Destiny point to add [AD] equal to ranks of Charm to an ally’s check. If that ally’s Duty triggered this session, add [TR] instead.

Talent.Name: Shift The Narrative
Talent.Description: Once per session, choose an organization and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Deception check[b]. On success, each member of that organization adds [SE] or [BO] to each check they make this session. The PC must have time and means to spread misinformation, and cannot use this action during a combat encounter.

Talent.Name: Martyrdom
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after being successfully hit by an attack, may suffer 3 strain to add [DE] to the check. The [DE] result added this way do not include the [FA] result that are normally part of them, only the negative effects of the symbol.

Talent.Name: Shift The Narrative (Improved)
Talent.Description: When taking the Shift The Narrative action, may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to increase or decrease the difficulty of the first check members of the targeted organization make each encounter this session.

Talent.Name: Shift The Narrative (Supreme)
Talent.Description: The group affected by Shift The Narrative increases or decreases their wound threshold by 1, plus an additional 1 for each additional [SU][SU][SU] until the end of the session.

Talent.Name: Find The Story
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Perception check[b] to identify a local compelling narrative. On success, add [SU] to all checks made to utilize that story this session.

Talent.Name: War of Ideas
Talent.Description: When a foe makes a social check to persuade a third party, may suffer strain up to ranks of Knowledge (Warfare) to add that many [SE] to the check. If it fails, upgrade the ability of all social checks targeting that party or the foe once for the remainder of the session. Multiple uses of this talent are not cumulative, this talent only ever upgrades those checks once.

Talent.Name: Emergency Outfitting
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] to reveal an undisclosed piece of personal gear, and may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to produce additional equipment equal to ranks of Vigilance.

Talent.Name: Substandard Issue
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception[b] or [B]Vigilance check[b] to determine that enemy equipment is substandard. Enemies equal to [SU][SU] add [TH][TH] to checks using this equipment in this encounter. The character may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have this affect all present enemies in the current scene.

Talent.Name: For A Good Cause
Talent.Description: Once per session, may spend 1 Destiny Point to reduce purchase price of a single object or service by 5% times the character’s Contribution Rank. If being used in a campaign not using Duty, the Game Master may decide the seller's disposition towards the character, and determine the price decrease that way.

Talent.Name: Misappropriate
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers[b] or [B]Skulduggery[b] check to reveal how a previously unknown theft or oversight has a meaningful impact on the scene. The player must justify how they or an intermediary had access to enemy supplies or logistics, and may spend [TR] to establish that the character or their allies has access to the missing resource instead, and may leverage it in the current scene.

Talent.Name: Well-Supplied
Talent.Description: Once per round when an ally attempts a skill check, may spend 25 credits times the difficulty of the check to add [SU] to that check. This talent may also be used on an allied Mass Combat check by spending 250 credits times the difficulty of the check, as determined by the size of the opposing force.

Talent.Name: Booby Trap
Talent.Description:
Once per encounter, the character may take the Booby Trap action to use materials in their environment to assemble a trap within short range. Each time another character moves to engaged range of the trap, they must make an [B]opposed Vigilance vs. Skulduggery check[b] against the character who placed the trap. If the character who triggers the trap fails, they suffer wounds (these ignore soak) equal to the trapper's Cunning characteristic, plus 1 additional wound per failure result. This damage profile may be changed to any explosive the character has available, adding 1 additional damage per [FA] on the check to notice the trap. This damage does not ignore soak. The trapper may spend [TH] generated to disorient the character for 1 round per [TH] spent, [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to immobilize the character for 1 round, and [DE] to stagger the character for 1 round.
[P]Once a character springs the trap, it is expended; at the GM's discretion, the trapper may spend [DE] from the check to have it remain functional for one extra use.
[P]The trapper may disarm the trap with an action. Any other character who is aware of the trap may spend several minutes attempting to disarm it with a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b]. If they fail, they suffer the damage and negative effects in the same manner as if they had triggered it.

Talent.Name: Masked Blast
Talent.Description: Before using explosives or otherwise making a large, noticeable, sound, the character may spend a Destiny Point to establish an even louder noise to mask it. This sound may be generated by the character, the environment, or some other source. Bystanders within earshot must make an [B]opposed Vigilance vs Stealth check[b] to notice the sound of the explosion.

Talent.Name: Master Saboteur
Talent.Description: Personal-scale explosives the character uses or sets gain Sunder, and each [AD] spent to activate the Sunder quality damages the target item two steps instead of one.

Talent.Name: Constructor
Talent.Description: When constructing bases, defenses, positions, or other similar combat engineering projects, add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Constructor.

Talent.Name: Constructor (Improved)
Talent.Description: While benefiting from cover from a position they have constructed, the character and allies increase their soak against ranged attacks by 1 per rank of Constructor.

Talent.Name: Counter-Mobility
Talent.Description: While defending a position, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b]. On [SU], foes treat an approach to this position out to extreme range as difficult terrain. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to increase range to planetary close.

Talent.Name: Counter-Mobility (Improved)
Talent.Description: Add [TH] to checks made by foes in the chosen approach. May spend [TH][TH][TH] from a foe’s check to immobilize them for rounds equal to characters ranks of Survival, or cause a minor collision.

Talent.Name: Conditioned (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session while falling, spend a Destiny point to reduce range bands fallen by ranks of Conditioned, to a minimum of Short. This affects the effective damage and strain suffered from the fall, not the fall distance itself.

Talent.Name: Field Researcher
Talent.Description: When the character makes a successful Knowledge check to gain information, reduce the difficulty of the next check they make to act on that knowledge by their ranks of Researcher, to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].

Talent.Name: Historian (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session when interacting with ancient or abandoned places or things, may spend 1 Destiny Point to cancel a [DE] or [TH] equal to ranks of Historian from a check the character or an ally makes.

Talent.Name: Knowledge In Action
Talent.Description: When making a skill check involving technology, tools, or mechanisms, the character may spend a Destiny Point to substitute a Knowledge skill, per Game Master discretion, instead of the required skill.

Talent.Name: Sterner Stuff
Talent.Description: Once per session, when the character would exceed their strain threshold, they may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] to reduce their strain to 1 below the strain threshold instead.

Talent.Name: Unearth the Answer
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Lore) check[b] to reveal that an item or place conceals a hidden secret that solves a problem in the current scene.

Talent.Name: Watch Your Step
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Athletics check[b] to have all other characters within short range suffer 1 wounds plus 1 wound per each [SU]. Spend [AD] to exclude an ally from this effect per each [AD] spent. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to Immobilize one affected enemy for one round. The nature of this triggered trap or hazards should be setting-appropriate, such as an ancient platform finally buckling under old age and fresh foot traffic. The character can either cause the trap or hazard to happen or may merely be reacting to it triggering.

Talent.Name: Hunter (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Before making a combat check against a non-sentient creature as a maneuver, suffer strain up to the target’s silhouette to reduce that attack's critical rating by the same amount, to a minimum of 1.

Talent.Name: Fine Tuning (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while engaged with or repairing a starship or vehicle, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to increase the system strain threshold of an the vessel by a number equal to the character's ranks in Fine Tuning for the rest of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover System Strain equal to ranks in Fine Tuning.

Talent.Name: Quick Pickup
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while piloting a starship or vehicle, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Piloting check[b] to have any number of allies within medium range of the craft board it as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Desperate Scramble
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B] Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coordination check[b] to escape confinement through a previously unknown method. On success, the character is able to escape and may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to allow allies to follow. The nature of the escape method is Game Master discretion, but may be highly improbable.

Talent.Name: Fearless Jump
Talent.Description: Once per session, may reroll a Astrogation check to make a hyperspace jump, and add [TR] [DE] to the result. [DE] added this way cannot be canceled by effects of talents, abilities, or equipment.

Talent.Name: Odd-Job
Talent.Description: Once per session, after successfully negotiating to purchase goods or services, the character may offer to perform a task or favor in lieu of payment. If this task is not performed before the end of the session, they take Obligation equal to the original difficulty of the check to purchase, or based on credit cost, or other narrative factors, per Game Master discretion.

Talent.Name: Master of None
Talent.Description: Once per round, add [SU] to a skill check the character makes using a skill that the they have less than 2 ranks in.

Talent.Name: Bolster (Improved)
Talent.Description: The benefits of the Bolster maneuver apply to all allies within short range as long as they remain within short range of the character.

Talent.Name: Keen Eyed (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B] Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Perception[b] or [B]Vigilance check[b] to add [SU] to next checks they and allies make to act on the observation. Decrease difficulty of check once per rank of Keen Eyed.

Talent.Name: Natural Remedy
Talent.Description: The character may use Survival instead of Medicine to heal wounds and critical injuries by increasing the difficulty of the check once.

Talent.Name: On The Lookout
Talent.Description: When making a check to determine initiative, spend a Destiny point to add [SU] to both their check and to a number of allies' equal to ranks in Cunning.

Talent.Name: Read The Wind
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b]. On success, a moderate ([SE][SE]) environmental effect appears. Spend [TR] for a severe ([SE][SE][SE]) environmental effect. This hazard could be weather, man-made actions, or natural disasters.

Talent.Name: Read the Wind (Improved)
Talent.Description: May suffer 2 strain to perform the Read The Wind action as a maneuver.

Talent.Name: Read the Wind (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may suffer a number of strain up to their ranks in Perception to remove that many [SE] imposed due to environmental conditions from an enemy’s check, adding an equal number of [FA] or [TH] to that check. If four or more [SE] are removed this way, add a single [DE] to the check instead of [FA] or [TH].

Talent.Name: It's a Bargain
Talent.Description: When buying goods, may have the item become damaged 1 step to reduce the price by 20%. Whether an item can be used while damaged is at Game Master discretion.

Talent.Name: It's A Steal
Talent.Description: When selling damaged or misrepresented goods, may make an opposed [B]Deception vs. Vigilance[b] check, and treat their value as if they were undamaged and genuine. Add [SE] for each step of damage the item has, and upgrade the difficulty of the check if the item is not genuine.

Talent.Name: Market Connections
Talent.Description: May make a [B]Knowledge (Core Worlds) or Knowledge (Outer Rim) check[b] to locate a local seller willing to sell a particular legal good, and add [SU] to checks to purchase that item from that seller. The skill required is based on locale, and the difficulty of the check is equal to half the item’s rarity, rounded down.

Talent.Name: Market Connections (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may use Market Connections to locate a seller of an illegal good by substituting Knowledge (Society) instead of the required skill and upgrading the difficulty of the check once.

Talent.Name: Market Connections (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from Market Connections action to have the seller include a related item with a value and rarity no greater than half that of the original item, rounded down, at no additional cost. The item include is at Game Master discretion.

Talent.Name: Wheel & Deal (Improved)
Talent.Description: When selling goods illegally, may upgrade the difficulty of the check once to gain 10% more credits per rank of Wheel and Deal. This includes locally restricted goods, stolen, and otherwise illegal goods.

Talent.Name: Something More Real
Talent.Description: Spend 1 Destiny Point when negotiating the cost of goods or services to introduce physical goods to be bartered, counting the value of those goods at 125% of their current value, instead of or in addition to credits. Modify the check based on legality and the item's level of damage.

Talent.Name: Personal Body Guard
Talent.Description: Once per encounter before an attack is made targeting an ally within short range, may move to their position and perform the Body Guard Maneuver as an out of turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Personal Body Guard (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session when performing the Body Guard Maneuver, may spend 1 Destiny point to have all attacks targeting the guarded character target the user instead until the user's next turn. Upgrade each attack targeting the character equal to the strain suffered performing the Body Guard maneuver.

Talent.Name: Saw it Coming
Talent.Description: Once per encounter; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check[b] to add [TH][TH] to all attacks made against the character or allies within short range until their next turn. Spend [TR] to add [FA] to those attacks.

Talent.Name: Time To Go (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when activating Time to Go, a number of allies equal to Cool may suffer 2 strain to also perform a maneuver as an out-of-turn move incidental to attempt to move into cover or out of the blast range of a weapon or explosion.

Talent.Name: Making A Door
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b] to treat an explosive as if it had the Breach 1 quality when breaching a specific structure or vehicle this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to treat it as if it had Breach 2 instead.

Talent.Name: Steady Nerves (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when performing a check involving a precise and/or dangerous technical action, may suffer strain up to ranks of Steady Nerves to downgrade the difficulty of the check that many times.

Talent.Name: Fearsome (Improved)
Talent.Description: May Spend [AD][AD] from Coercion checks or [TH][TH] from foes’ Discipline check to have the target suffer strain equal to ranks of Fearsome.

Talent.Name: Sending a Message
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, after incapacitating a foe or inflicting a critical injury, suffer 3 strain to add [TH] to all checks made this encounter by foes within Medium range equal to Willpower.

Talent.Name: …Or Else
Talent.Description: Once per session, after the character or an ally within Short range makes a Coercion check that fails or results in [DE] spend a Destiny Point to add [TR] to the result.

Talent.Name: Lock and Load
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may load or reload a weapon as an incidental, including those with the limited ammo quality. This talent reduces the amount of time to draw or stow a weapon that usually requires more than one maneuver to properly prepare or stow by 1 maneuver, or reduces its Prepare quality by 1.

Talent.Name: Suppressing Fire (Improved)
Talent.Description: Foes who suffer strain from the effects of the character’s Suppressing Fire and foes within short range of the targeted character upgrade the difficulty of their next check once.

Talent.Name: Juggernaut
Talent.Description: When the character suffers a critical injury, spend a Destiny Point to reduce the Critical Injury result by 10 per rank of Resilience, to a minimum of 1.

Talent.Name: Kill Or Be Killed
Talent.Description: Once per session when exceeding wound threshold, spend a Destiny Point to make a melee attack. If the target dies, wounds become equal to ranks of Resilience below threshold instead.

Talent.Name: Savage Response
Talent.Description: When the character suffers a critical injury if they aren't incapacitated, suffer 3 strain to inflict a hit with an equipped Melee or Brawl weapon on an engaged foe. This hit deals the weapon's base damage plus any damage from applicable talents or abilities.

Talent.Name: Unyielding
Talent.Description: After being hit by a ranged attack, suffer 2 strain to perform a Move maneuver as an out of turn incidental toward the attacker.

Talent.Name: Focus Fire
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, increase the difficulty of your next ranged combat check by 1. If successful, upgrade the ability of each combat check made against the target once until the end of the character’s next turn.

Talent.Name: Persistent Targeting (Improved)
Talent.Description: After the character makes one or more successful combat checks against a target allies within short range of the character add [BO] to combat checks against that target for the remainder of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Cargo Drop
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b] to dump the ship’s cargo. Foes within short range equal to [SU] must drop to speed 1 or suffer a major collision. The character may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to trigger any additional effects, based on the nature of the cargo dropped, and Game Master determination.

Talent.Name: Mustafar Special
Talent.Description: Once per round, may make an opposed Piloting vs Piloting check against starship or vehicle within close range. On Success, that craft suffers system strain equal to ranks in Cunning plus [SU]. Spend [AD][AD] to affect an additional craft within close range.

Talent.Name: Stellar Distraction
Talent.Description: When a foe makes a check to detect, scan, or identify a starship the character is aboard, may spend 1 Destiny Point to upgrade the difficulty of that check a number of times equal to ranks in Astrogation.

Talent.Name: Wretched Hive
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation[b] or [B]Knowledge (Underworld) check[b] to identify the path to the nearest Shadowport. Upgrade all checks to travel to and interact with the Shadowport this session.

Talent.Name: Energy Siphon
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make an [B]Opposed Athletics vs Athletics check[b] against an engaged foe to drain the energy from an equipped, powered item and recover strain equal to total encumbrance of drained item(s). Spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to drain an additional equipped item. Items drained cease functioning until either recharged or reloaded.

Talent.Name: Master Cyberneticist
Talent.Description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of the next check made to heal a cyborg or to create, install, repair, or activate a cybernetic once. This does not apply to checks that incidentally include the use of cybernetics.

Talent.Name: Stronger Than Flesh
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may avoid suffering a [DI] or [DI][DI] severity critical injury by having an installed cybernetic immediately malfunction. It provides no benefit until the character spends several hours making an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to repair it.

Talent.Name: Stronger Than Flesh (Improved)
Talent.Description: Stronger Than Flesh may also be used to avoid crits of [DI][DI][DI] or [DI][DI][DI][DI] severity.

Talent.Name: Stronger Than Flesh (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Immediately after being successfully attacked but before suffering damage, spend 1 Destiny Point to increase the character's Soak by half the number of their installed cybernetics, rounded up.

Talent.Name: Emergency Bypass
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when an engaged starship or vehicle suffers a critical hit, spend a Destiny Point and have the engaged starship or vehicle suffer system strain equal to the severity of that critical hit to choose a different critical hit of the same severity.

Talent.Name: Signature Superiority
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while aboard the Signature Vehicle, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b]. On [SU], the character and a number of allies equal to the character’s Intellect add [SU] to all checks involving the signature Vehicle until the end of the character's next turn.

Talent.Name: Tinkerer (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session as an incidental, spend a Destiny Point. For each item benefiting from the character's Tinkerer, add [AD] equal to the character's ranks in Tinkerer to the next check using it.

Talent.Name: Percussive Maintenance*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter as a maneuver, before making a check to repair or damage an engaged machine, starship, vehicle, or droid, suffer 2 wounds to add [BO] equal to the character's ranks of Melee or Brawl (whichever is higher) to the check.

Talent.Name: Signature Vehicle (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character’s Signature Vehicle may have a silhouette or 5 or less. Increase the character’s Signature Vehicle's top speed by 1, to a maximum of speed 6.

Talent.Name: Special Modifications
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to temporarily convert an attachment currently installed on equipment or a vehicle into another valid attachment with equal or lesser hard points and rarity. They may make this permanent by spending 6 hours and spending credits equal to the new attachment's cost minus the cost of the original attachment.

Talent.Name: Unlocked Potential
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character or an ally within short range may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a check using a modded vehicle or piece of equipment to temporarily install a uninstalled Mod of an installed attachment of that item or vehicle until the end of the session (including a previously failed mod option). Additional [TR] may be spent from this or a subsequent check using the weapon or vehicle this session, paying normal modding costs, to unlock it permanently.

Talent.Name: Make It Dangerous
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform the Make It Dangerous maneuver; the character makes a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] to add choice of Burn 1, Sunder, or Vicious 1 to a weapon within engaged range until the end of the character's next turn. If that weapon already has that quality, increase it by one rank. The Game Master may spend [TH][TH] or [DE] on this check or any check made using the weapon before this effect expires to damage it one step.

Talent.Name: Make It Dangerous (Improved)
Talent.Description: Suffer 1 strain to decrease the difficulty of Make it Dangerous to [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b]. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] so that all critical injuries inflicted by an attack using this weapon result in a Crippled effect, unless the roll would result in a more grievous injury. This effect lasts until Make It Dangerous expires.

Talent.Name: Delayed Response
Talent.Description: Once per session after being detected or discovered, may spend 1 Destiny Point to delay alarm, pursuit or reprisal until the end of the character's next turn.

Talent.Name: Forceful Expulsion
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computerscheck[b] to eject another character accessing a connected system. Spend [AD][AD] from this check or on a successful Eject User check to inflict strain equal to ranks of [B]Knowledge (Education)[b], and spend [TR] to render the chosen character's slicer's gear or access point unusable.

Talent.Name: Ghost in the Machine
Talent.Description: Suffer strain up to ranks in Stealth to add an equal number of [SE] or remove an equal number of [BO] from checks to trace, locate, or identify the character while they are slicing, including physical discovery.

Talent.Name: Logic Bomb
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers Check[b] and choose a connected system or device the character has access to, and a triggering event. On success, when the event occurs, the character may immediately enact a single command of their choice to that system or have it shut down, chosen at the time of triggering.

Talent.Name: Shadowfeed Secret
Talent.Description: Once per session, may choose target location or faction, or person and make a [B]Knowledge (Underworld) check[b] with a difficulty based on the target. On [SU], may add [TR] to a Computers check to slice that target this session.

Talent.Name: Gliding Step
Talent.Description: Add [BO] to melee attacks for each move maneuver performed this round.

Talent.Name: Make It Count
Talent.Description: Once per round, after an enemy cripples, destroys, or inflicts a critical hit on their ship or an allied ship within short range, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [AD][AD] to the next check made by a number of allies equal to Presence.

Talent.Name: Bad Motivator (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session when taking the Bad Motivator action, the character may choose a trigger or circumstance under which the device will fail, rather than it failing immediately. The device functions normally until that trigger occurs.

Talent.Name: Improvised Detonation (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When taking the Improvised Detonation action, may add Burn +1, Concussive +1, Ensnare +1, Ion, Knockdown, Pierce +2, Stun +2, and/or Stun Damage qualities to the explosive, upgrading the difficulty of the check once for each quality chosen. Any number of qualities may be chosen, but each ranked option may only be chosen three times.

Talent.Name: Jack of All Trades
Talent.Description: When making a skill check using a skill with fewer ranks than their ranks of Jack Of All Trades, suffer a number of strain up to the difference to upgrade the ability of the check that many times.

Talent.Name: Inspiring Leadership
Talent.Description: The character may take the Inspiring Leadership action by making an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Leadership check[b]. If successful, a number of allies not exceeding his rating in presence within a short range add automatic [SU] to their next skill check.

Talent.Name: Most Impressive
Talent.Description: The character may spend [TR] from any skill check to allow a number of allies not excluding his rating in Presence within short range to add automatic [AD] to their next skill check.

Talent.Name: Pride and Joy
Talent.Description: The character schooses one starship or vehicle with a silhouette of 4 or higher that they owns. This vessel is the character's "Pride and Joy" vessel. They upgrade the ability of all social skill checks they makes while within short range of the vessel once. If the vessel is ever lost or destroyed, the character may apply Pride and Joy to a new starship or vehicle that meets the requirements. The process of modifying and acclimating to the new vessel may take some time at the GM's discression. No two characters can have the same vessel as their Pride and Joy.

Talent.Name: Pride and Joy (Improved)
Talent.Description: While inside their Pride and Joy vessel, the character recovers one additional strain whenever they recover strain and may spend [AD] on checks made to recover strain to allow and ally also within the vessel to recover one strain.

Talent.Name: Pride and Joy (Supreme)
Talent.Description: While inside their Pride and Joy vessel, once per session the character may reduce this vessel's silhouette by two (to a minimum of 0) for the remainder of the round and the following round. This lowered silhouette is used only for purposes of combat and movement, it does not physically reduce the size of the vessel.

Talent.Name: Trust the Captain
Talent.Description: May take the Trust the Captain action by making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check[b]. If successful, for the rest of the encounter allies within short range increase their ranks in Discipline by an amount equal to ranks in Trust the Captain.

Talent.Name: Improved Dodge
Talent.Description: When the character performs the Dodge incidental, the character may make a Move maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental after the triggering attack has been resolved.

Talent.Name: Toughened (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may heal a number of wounds equal to their ranks in Toughened.

Talent.Name: Boring Conversation Anyway
Talent.Description: Once per round, may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] on a social check to immediately make an attack against the target of that social check as an incidental.

Talent.Name: Double-Cross
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b]. On success, the character (or player) reveals how their previously unknown scheming has a meaningful impact on the current scene or encounter. The nature of the revelation and its impact on the scene are ultimately subject to the GM's discretion, but should inflict significant danger or disadvantage to an adversarial character. If the check fails and generates a despair result, however, the GM may decide that the character is actually the one being double-crossed.

Talent.Name: Master of Dealing
Talent.Description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce the difficulty of next check to find, buy, or sell stolen, contraband or illegal goods once.

Talent.Name: Diagnostician
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check[b]. On success, the character (or player) details an observation they've made of a character within short range that reveals a medical condition they are suffering from. This condition may be purely narrative in nature and effect, but the Game Master may choose to impose negative effects on the diagnosed character.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Do No Harm*
Talent.Description: Once per session, take the Do No Harm action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check[b]. If successful, may not be targeted by combat checks until the end of the encounter, or until making a combat check. A Game Master may end this effect due to the character doing anything that would obviously injure, impede, or confound the enemy.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Doctor's Orders*
Talent.Description: When recovering under your supervision, characters heal an additional wound whenever they passively heal wounds, and add [SU] to any check to heal their critical injuries.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Surgeon (Improved)*
Talent.Description: When performing a Medicine check, may suffer strain up to ranks of Surgeon, then choose to either remove that many [SE] or add that many [BO].
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Voice of Reason*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when making Leadership or Negotiation skill check, the character may use a Knowledge skill instead. Check uses Presence and player must explain how, in this particular instance, their Knowledge skill is persuading others or driving the conversation.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Heal Thyself*
Talent.Description: When performing a check to heal themselves, may substitute Resilience instead of the required skill to avoid increasing the difficulty of the check. This includes Mechanics checks to heal cyborgs or droids, but does not apply to Resilience checks to passively heal critical injuries. Talents that affect Medicine checks still apply to this roll.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Captive Audience
Talent.Description: Once per session, may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Deception check[b] to captivate a group of people with a performance. On [SU], add [FA] to checks made by audience for the duration of the performance. May spend [TR] to add [FA][FA] instead.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Lighten the Mood
Talent.Description: When recovering at the end of an encounter, may roll [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Charm[b] check. On Success, allies equal to Presence add [SU] to their recovery rolls. The character may spend [AD][AD] to have an affected ally add an additional [SU] to their check, and may spend [TR] to recover the same number of strain as one affected ally.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Cannibalize*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may scrap an existing piece of similar gear to add [SU] to a check to create, improve or repair another piece of gear, mechanical object, starship, or vehicle.

Talent.Name: Field Calibration*
Talent.Description: May make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to add [SU] to the next check made by an ally using an engaged Vessel or piece of Equipment, and may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to extend this effect to an additional check.

Talent.Name: Field Calibration (Improved)*
Talent.Description: Once per round, may suffer 2 strain to perform Field Calibration as a maneuver.

Talent.Name: Just Like New*
