Talent.Description: Spend a Destiny Point to treat a non-destroyed piece of equipment within medium range as if it isn’t damaged until the end of the character's next turn.

Talent.Name: Kitbash*
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] and scrap a piece of gear to combine it with a vehicle or item with a larger silhouette, granting the latter item or vehicle a quality or feature from the scrapped item. The character may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to reduce the [AD] cost to activate the chosen quality or feature by 1, to a minimum of 1. The GM may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] on a future check using the item to have the kitbashed feature permanently fail, removing it from the larger device. An item may only benefit from one instance of Kitbash at a time. If Kitbash is ever applied to an item more than once, the previous iteration's effects are overwritten.

Talent.Name: Solid Repairs (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to increase the armor of an engaged starship or vehicle by 1 until the end of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover hull trauma equal to the character's ranks of Solid Repairs.

Talent.Name: Design Flaw (Improved)*
Talent.Description: Take the Improved Design Flaw action; Make an [B]opposed Computers vs Discipline check[b] targeting a disabled or restrained droid, downgrading the difficulty of that check once per rank of Design Flaw the character possesses. On success, the character extracts useful information from the target’s databanks, and may spend [AD][AD] to alter information in the droid’s databanks, and/or [TR] to change a significant part of the droid’s base programming, including their loyalty and prime directive.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Directive*
Talent.Description: Once per round as a maneuver, suffer strain no more than ranks in Directive. Upgrade the ability of the next check made by an allied droid within short range a number of times equal to strain suffered.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Improved Directive*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when performing the Directive maneuver, may affect an additional allied droid per rank of Directive, and the range of Directive increases to medium.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Supreme Directive*
Talent.Description: Once per session, choose a skill and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check[b]. On success, a number of allied droids within medium range up to ranks of Directive may treat their ranks of that skill as equal the character’s ranks until end of character’s next turn. Spend [TR] to extend this effect 1 round.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Final Directive*
Talent.Description: Once per session, when an allied droid would be incapacitated or destroyed, may spend 1 Destiny Point to allow that droid to make an immediate maneuver, followed by an action.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Accomplished Accomplice*
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, per Droid Companion, when an ally within short range of a Droid Companion would fail a check, the character may spend a Destiny Point to roll [BO] equal to that Droid Companion’s ranks in that skill, adding the results to the failed check.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Droid Companion*
Talent.Description: Choose a willing PC or NPC droid as a Droid Companion. Choose two skills. The Droid Companion adds automatic [AD] to checks using those skills. These skills may be changed with a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers check[b] and six hours of reprogramming. If the droid is lost or destroyed, the character may apply Droid Companion to a new droid. The process of modifying and acclimating to the new droid is at the GM's discretion. No two characters may have the same Droid Companion.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Binary Companions*
Talent.Description: The Character may choose an additional willing PC or NPC droid as an additional Droid Companion per rank of Binary Companions. The character may choose different skills to add [AD] to for each Droid Companion.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Machine Mender (Improved)
Talent.Description: When making a check to repair a droid, the character may spend [AD][AD] a number of times up to rank of Machine Mender to increase any combination the droid’s melee or ranged defense once per [AD][AD] spent until the end of the session, and may spend [TR] to increase its Soak by 1.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Thank The Maker!
Talent.Description: Once per session per Droid Companion, when a Droid Companion would be incapacitated or destroyed, spend a Destiny Point. It is not defeated until the end of the character’s next turn. If the droid is mechanically stabilized before the effect ends, it is not incapacitated or destroyed.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Repair Patch Specialization (Improved)*
Talent.Description: Once per droid per encounter, after applying a repair patch to a Droid, that droid adds [SU][AD] to the next check they make this encounter.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Compelling Counterpart*
Talent.Description: Choose one social skill per Droid Companion. While engaged with Droid Companion, add [AD] to checks using the chosen skill.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Dazzling Flourish
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a melee attack check to upgrade the ability of the next attack of each ally targeting that enemy.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Center of Attention*
Talent.Description: While making a social or performance check before a gathering or audience, may suffer 2 strain to gain [TR] on success or [DE] on failure. The [TR] or [DE] results added this way do not include the success or failure results that are usually part of them, only the beneficial or negative effects of the symbol.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Army of One
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after inflicting a critical injury or incapacitating a foe, the character may spend a Destiny Point to immediately make an attack against a different foe within range of an equipped weapon.

Talent.Name: Finish the Fight
Talent.Description: After being successfully attacked, the character may suffer 2 strain to add damage equal to their ranks of Resilience to one hit of each attack they make before the end of their next turn.

Talent.Name: Finish the Fight (Improved)
Talent.Description: After activating the Finish The Fight incidental, the character also adds 10 times their ranks of Resilience to the results of any Critical Injuries they inflict before the end of their next turn.

Talent.Name: Outflank
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform a move maneuver as an incidental, then choose an enemy within range of an equipped weapon. Remove [SE][SE] from next attack the character makes against the chosen enemy this turn. This cannot allow the character to perform more than two maneuvers to move in a turn.

Talent.Name: Tactical Dodge
Talent.Description: After the character uses the Dodge incidental, if the incoming attack misses, the character upgrades the ability of the next attack the character makes against the attacker a number of times equal to the amount of strain suffered to activate Dodge this attack.

Talent.Name: Evac Training
Talent.Description: The character ignores the encumbrance value of one character and their gear while carrying one or more other characters. A Game Master may determine some gear cannot be easily transported along with the carried character. The character adds [BO][BO] to Athletics and Coordination checks imposed due to carrying one or more characters.

Talent.Name: Powerful Stims
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after administering a stim or stimpack, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [SU] to each check made by the character who received the stim or stimpack until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Universal Relief
Talent.Description: Once per session, choose a species and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check[b]. On success, the character adds [AD][AD] to the first check they make or assist with to interact with or heal each member of that species this session.

Talent.Name: Dead-Eye
Talent.Description: The character may benefit from a third aim maneuver on Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks. It adds an additional [BO] if aiming normally, or removes an additional [SE] if aiming at a specific subset of the target.

Talent.Name: Dialed In
Talent.Description: Perform the Dialed In maneuver; make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Perception check[b] to treat all Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks as if their maximum range was one ranged band further until the character moves more than short range from the spot they dialed in from or the encounter ends.

Talent.Name: Dialed In (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from Dialed In to decrease the difficulty of all Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) attacks they make at Long or Extreme Range.

Talent.Name: One Shot, One Kill
Talent.Description: Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks the character makes gain +2 Pierce for each aim maneuver they are benefiting from.

Talent.Name: Overwatch
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, before a foe moves or acts, may make an [B]opposed Cool vs Vigilance check[b] against that foe, adding any relevant [BO] due to aiming. On success, they suffer a hit from an equipped ranged weapon with the appropriate range to attack the target plus 1 Damage per [SU]. The character may spend [AD] or [TR] results to inflict Critical Injuries and activate weapon qualities.

Talent.Name: Tight Grouping
Talent.Description: After making a Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) attack while aiming, if there is a foe within short range of the original target, or the original target isn't defeated, the character may suffer strain up to the number of aims the attack was benefiting from to aim that many times as an incidental.

Talent.Name: Ambusher
Talent.Description: Once per round when benefiting from cover or concealment, may make the Ambusher maneuver. Add damage equal to Stealth skill to one hit of the next successful non-starship/vehicle combat check made against a target within Medium range before the end of their turn.

Talent.Name: Exploit Weakness
Talent.Description: Add [BO][BO] to attacks made against Disoriented, Immobilized, involuntarily prone, poisoned, Staggered, or incapacitated targets. Per GM discretion, other status effects may apply such as fires, acids, or particularly debilitating critical injuries.

Talent.Name: Guerrila Warfare
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point. Until the end of the next round, the characters and their allies within Medium range may disengage from an enemy or enter cover once per turn as an incidental.

Talent.Name: Lay of the Land
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Outer Rim) check[b] to establish an environmental factor that they are prepared for but an enemy faction is not. For all relevant checks this encounter, the character and their allies add [AD] and the chosen faction add [TH]. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to increase the Defense rating granted by relevant cover by 1 (to a maximum of 3), and [TR] to have the enemy faction treat all relevant environments as difficult terrain.

Talent.Name: Road Less Traveled
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception[b] or [B]Survival check[b] to establish a temporary shortcut between their present location and a location within Extreme range. As long as they stay on the shortcut, maneuvers the character and allies make to move directly towards the end location may move twice the distance this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to add [SU] to all Stealth checks made by those on the path.

Talent.Name: Danger Close
Talent.Description: When the character engages a foe during combat, that foe adds [FA] to their next check.

Talent.Name: Danger Close (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character engages one or more foes during combat, the character adds [SU] to their next check.

Talent.Name: Heroic Charge
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may perform the Heroic Charge maneuver and suffer 2 strain to move to engage a character within Medium range that the character could otherwise reach.

Talent.Name: Heroic Charge (Improved)
Talent.Description: After making the Heroic Charge maneuver, upgrade the difficulty of all ranged attacks targeting the character once until their next turn.

Talent.Name: Fearless Diversion
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check[b] to draw the fire of enemies. A number of foes within medium range equal to [SU] must suffer 3 strain to attack an ally until the end of the next round. Each [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] may be spent to add [FA] to each attack targeting the character, and [TR] can be spent to determine an affected enemy cannot target anyone but the character.

Talent.Name: Bulwark
Talent.Description: If the character has attacked this round, allies within short range increase their Ranged defense by 1.

Talent.Name: Collateral Damage
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after they miss an attack with an explosive or ordinance weapon, the character may spend a Destiny Point to reroll the attack against a different target within range. If the attack has the Guided quality and generated at least two uncancelled [AD] or a [TR], they may activate this incidental without spending a Destiny Point.

Talent.Name: Disruptive
Talent.Description: Suffer a number of strain to downgrade the difficulty of a Computers check, or upgrade the difficulty when opposing a Computers check, by an equal number. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Disruptive.

Talent.Name: Disruptive (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD] from a Computers check or [TH][TH] when opposing a foe's computers check to add [FA] equal to the character's ranks of Disruptive to a foe's next Computers check in that system.

Talent.Name: Hunter (Improved)
Talent.Description: After the character inflicts a critical injury on or incapacitates a foe with an attack, or otherwise causes a critical injury or incapacitation of a foe, the character may perform a maneuver as an incidental. This does not allow the character to perform more than 2 maneuvers per turn, but may allow them to make maneuvers out-of-turn.

Talent.Name: Bolstering Presence*
Talent.Description: Once per session, when an ally within Medium range would exceed their strain threshold, may spend 1 Destiny Point to have them recover strain equal to the character’s [B]Presence[b].

Talent.Name: Reverse Engineering (Improved)*
Talent.Description: May scrap the original item instead of paying credits when taking the Reverse Engineering action. May also spend [TR] to grant the item the [B]Superior[b] quality at the cost of one Hard Point or 0 Hard Points if the item doesn't have Hard Points. If this item is not a weapon or armor, it gains a narrative benefit chosen by the Game Master and the Player.

Talent.Name: Custom Code
Talent.Description: When your character selects this talent they choose one icebreaker or piece of ice that they own. If they choose an icebreaker, whenever they use that icebreaker to override ice, they add [AD] to the results. If they choose a piece of ice, whenever someone else attempts to override it, they add [TH] to the results.

Talent.Name: Custom Rig
Talent.Description: When your character selects this talent they choose one computer (such as a rig, PAD, or spinal modem) that they own. The amount of ice or icebreakers (your character's choice) that they can have on that computer is increased by 1 per rank of Custom Rig. (This may be a mix of ice and icebreakers, as long as the combined total increase does not exceed your character's ranks in Custom Rig). If your character loses their affected computer, they may choose a new computer to be affected by this talent.

Talent.Name: Nexus Search
Talent.Description: When your character has access to the Nexus, they can use this talent to upgrade the ability of the next Knowledge check they make that turn twice, and the difficulty of the check once. [DE] means that they learn some seemingly relevant and believable information that turns out to be completely (and possibly maliciously) false.

Talent.Name: Codeslinger
Talent.Description: When your character performs the activate program maneuver in a hacking encounter, they can choose not to deactivate one other active icebreaker. They may have two icebreakers active at once.

Talent.Name: Nexus Hunter
Talent.Description: When your character successfully traces another character during a Network encounter, your character gains one additional trace.

Talent.Name: Nexus Warrior
Talent.Description: While accessing a system using a brain-machine interface (BMI), your character may use this talent to make an opposed Computers (Hacking) versus Computers (Sysops) check targeting one other character on the system that they are aware of. The target suffers 1 strain per [SU], and if they are using a BMI, they also suffer 1 wound per [SU].

Talent.Name: Command Override
Talent.Description:
As long as they have some sort of access point to the Nexus, your character may use this talent to make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers (Hacking)[b] check . If they succeed, they may select one drone, vehicle, or piece of equipment involved in the current encounter and dictate its actions until the start of your character's next turn.
[BR]Alternatively, your character can select someone with cybernetic implants or who is wearing powered armor or an exosuit and manipulate it until the beginning of your character's next turn. This must be approved by your GM but could include shutting off cybereyes, directing the movements of cyberlimbs, or causing an exosuit to eject its occupant.
[BR]Your character may spend [AD][AD][AD] on the check to extend the effects for one additional round, or they may spend [TR] to extend the effects for the remainder of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Web of Knowledge
Talent.Description:
Once per session your character may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (The Nexus) check[b] during a Nexus encounter. If you succeed, your character knows the names, strengths, and other qualities of all ice (active or deactivated) on one system that you currently have access to, as well as all other characters (sysops and runners) that currently are accessing that system.
[BR]Your character may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from this check (whether or not they succeeded) to add [SU] to all Computer checks involving that system that they make for the remainder of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Burn Through
Talent.Description: After making a successful break ice action, your character may suffer 3 strain to use this talent. If they do, they may perform a second override ice action on the same system as an incidental.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Hit The Deck
Talent.Description: After determining the character would be hit by an explosive, but before damage is applied, spend a Destiny point to perform a move maneuver as an incidental to move into cover or out of the blast radius of a weapon or explosion.

Talent.Name: Hit The Deck (Improved)
Talent.Description: When activating Hit The Deck, allies within short range of the character equal to Cool or Vigilance may also perform a Move maneuver as an incidental to move into cover out of a blast radius of a weapon or explosion.

Talent.Name: Explosive Surprise
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b] to establish how a previously existing device or explosive the character possesses has been covertly placed somewhere within long range of them. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to allow the character to make an [B]Easy ([DI]) Mechanics check[b] as an incidental to activate or detonate the device while they are within extreme range of it. How the device was hidden is at the Game Master's discretion.

Talent.Name: Overkill
Talent.Description: Once per attack when the character causes a foe to exceed their wound threshold, the character may suffer 2 strain to assign a hit dealing damage equal to the incapacitating hit's damage minus the original target's soak to another foe within short range of the first. If this is a melee attack, the second target must be engaged rather than short range.

Talent.Name: Where It Hurts
Talent.Description: Once per encounter as a maneuver, the character may suffer strain up to their ranks in Perception and choose a foe within long range. The character's attacks targeting the foe increase their Pierce rating equal to the number of strain suffered this way until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Bolster
Talent.Description: As a maneuver, the character may remove [SE] per rank of Bolster imposed by a single environmental circumstance from all actions they make this encounter. This may be used multiple times to remove setbacks imposed by additional environmental circumstances.

Talent.Name: Killer Instinct
Talent.Description: Unarmed and improvised weapons attacks the character makes gain a Pierce equal to their ranks in Survival.

Talent.Name: Kill Confirmed
Talent.Description: Once per session, upgrade the difficulty of the next ranged attack the character makes once to have one hit of that attack ignore the target's soak. The Game Master may spend [TH][TH] or [DE] to have the weapon run out of ammo or otherwise malfunction.

Talent.Name: Follow My Lead
Talent.Description: Once per round, spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from a check to allow an ally within short range count as having the same number of ranks of that skill as the character for the next check they make using that skill.

Talent.Name: No Time To Bleed
Talent.Description: Once per session, as a maneuver, spend a Destiny Point to recover strain and/or wounds in any combination up to ranks in Discipline.

Talent.Name: Makashi Finish
Talent.Description: Take the Makashi Finish action; Perform a [B]Lightsaber (Presence) combat check[b] against engaged target, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add +10 to any resulting Critical Injury rolls.

Talent.Name: Secrets of the Jedi
Talent.Description: Lightsaber becomes a career skill. He may also decrease to difficulty of checks made to construct or repair melee weapons a number of times equal to half his ranks in Knowledge (Lore) (rounded up), to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].

Talent.Name: Fly Casual
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while piloting, spend a Destiny Point to add [SE] equal to Cunning to a check made to identify, scan, or investigate the craft or its contents.

Talent.Name: Dynamic Personality
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after making a successful social check, suffer strain up to the character's Presence to increase or decrease an affected character's defense by that number until the end of the next round. This cannot increase a character's defenses above 4.

Talent.Name: Friends in Low Places
Talent.Description: Add [AD] per rank of Friends In Low Places to check the character makes to find or interact with the criminal element.

Talent.Name: Swindler*
Talent.Description: Add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Swindler from checks to lie, cheat, steal, or commit subterfuge. Applicable checks are per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Opportunist
Talent.Description: The character adds a [BO] per rank of Opportunist to combat checks made against enemies who have attacked an ally this round, or are otherwise distracted, per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Freerunning (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When falling, the character reduces the number of range bands they fall by one. If falling less than short range, they suffer no ill effects from falling.

Talent.Name: Go To Ground
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check[b] to establish a nearby location the character and their allies can lie low. If a base or safehouse already exists, add [SU] to checks made by the character or allies to reach it this session.

Talent.Name: In Plain Sight
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check[b]. On success, add [SU] to all checks the character makes to avoid scrutiny or identification, and [FA] to all checks made to identify or scrutinize the character this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to extend these benefits to allies while they remain within short range.

Talent.Name: Hand Off*
Talent.Description: Once per round, as an out-of-turn incidental, suffer 2 strain to covertly pick up or hide an engaged item that is encumbrance 1 or smaller, or exchange up to two items that are encumbrance 1 or smaller with an ally within short range. If the character is being closely watched, an [B]opposed Perception vs. Skulduggery check[b] can be made to notice the exchange, adding [SE][SE] to the pool.

Talent.Name: Incite Distraction (Improved)
Talent.Description: While piloting in traffic, a successful Incite Distraction check reduces the handling of foes' craft within medium range by 2 until the end of the character's next turn. Spend [TR] to reduce the speed of those craft to 0.

Talent.Name: Package Secured
Talent.Description: Once per session when a valuable carried item is at imminent risk of being lost, stolen or discovered, spend a Destiny Point to add [TR] or [DE] to any one check related to maintaining control of the object.

Talent.Name: Cover Your Tracks
Talent.Description: After incapacitating one or more foes, spend a Destiny Point to conceal the evidence of the attack. An opposed Stealth check against the character must be made to discover the attack.

Talent.Name: Get In, Get Out
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery[b] or [B]Stealth check[b] to establish a previously unknown entry point to a structure or vehicle that the character and allies equal to Cunning may immediately use to infiltrate, even if it were otherwise impassable. Spend [TR] to allow stealthy exit through that point without requiring further checks.

Talent.Name: Silent Takedown
Talent.Description: Once per encounter before making an attack against a target within short range, perform this maneuver. If that attack incapacitates the target, the attack is silent. The GM determines if a weapon can be used silently.

Talent.Name: Silent Takedown (Improved)
Talent.Description: Add [AD][AD] to attacks benefiting from Silent Takedown.

Talent.Name: Subterfuge
Talent.Description: Once per session, make an [B]opposed Deception check[b] against a foe within short range to draw them in or lower their guard. On success, add [TR] to the next combat check the character makes against the foe before the end of the character’s next turn. Outside of structured time, this attack may be made immediately.

Talent.Name: Bedside Manners
Talent.Description: Add [AD][AD] to social checks the character makes against targets they have medically treated this encounter, or [SU][TH][TH] against those they have tortured, physically or otherwise.

Talent.Name: Flip the Script
Talent.Description: Once per session when a foe targets an ally within short range of the character with a social check, spend a Destiny Point to have that ally make the same check against the foe instead. This check benefits from skilled assistance from the character.

Talent.Name: Loose Lips...
Talent.Description: Once per session, make an [B]opposed Charm vs Cool[b] or [B]Deception vs Discipline check[b] against a non-hostile NPC to glean actionable intelligence. On success, add [TR] to a check the character or an ally makes that uses this intel while acting against the target NPC's organization.

Talent.Name: Potent Tinctures
Talent.Description: Foes upgrade the difficulty of checks made to resist the effects of poisons that were created or administered by the character once per rank of Potent Tinctures.

Talent.Name: ...Sink Ships
Talent.Description: After the character successfully takes the …Loose Lips action, they may choose to add [DE] to a check relevant to the intel made by the target NPC’s organization instead of adding [TR].

Talent.Name: Death Before Discovery
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to add [TR] to a combat check the character makes against someone who has just or is about to uncover their identity or mission.

Talent.Name: Enough to Get By
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, suffer two strain to add [BO] equal to the character’s ranks of Knowledge (Education) to a single check they make.

Talent.Name: False Trail
Talent.Description: Add [SE] per rank of False Trail to checks to investigate, scrutinize, or interrogate the character. Spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to implicate or redirect suspicion to a specific third party known to the character. The GM may add equivalent [BO] to similar checks the character makes instead.

Talent.Name: Of Many Faces
Talent.Description: At the beginning of each session, choose one unranked skill in which the character possesses no ranks to gain two temporary ranks, or two unranked skills to gain one rank each. This effect lasts until at the end of the session.

Talent.Name: Sleeper Activate
Talent.Description: Once per session when voluntarily abandoning a cover story, façade or persona, as an incidental, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool[b] or [B]Discipline check[b]. On Success, add [SU] to all checks the character makes this encounter. Spend [TR] to reduce the difficulty of those checks once instead.

Talent.Name: Unwitting Accomplice
Talent.Description: Once per session while undercover, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Deception check[b] to have a character in the scene, or one that conveniently appears, vouch for the character’s cover story. That character provides assistance on social checks for the remainder of the scene, per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: False Trail (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may choose to upgrade the difficulty of affected checks a number of times equal to their ranks of False Trail instead of its normal effects. Spend [DE] to describe how the character laid the trap that implicated the foe making the check.

Talent.Name: According to My Design
Talent.Description: Once per session after a check the character or an ally within medium range makes results in [DE], suffer 4 strain to add [TR] to that check. The player should establish how they planned for exactly this eventuality.

Talent.Name: Asset Acquired
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend [AD][AD][AD] from a Streetwise or Social check made to gather information to increase the members within an intelligence network or the scope of a contact network once until the end of session.

Talent.Name: Blending In
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to make a Stealth check with Cunning instead of Agility.

Talent.Name: Compromised
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion[b] or [B]Deception check[b]. On a success, a foe is convinced the character has compromising evidence, and will assist the character for the rest of the encounter, per GM discretion. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have the foe assist the character for the rest of the session, instead.

Talent.Name: Eyes and Ears Everywhere
Talent.Description: When in a well-populated or urban location, the character may substitute Streetwise for checks to determine initiative. The Game Master determines which locations qualify.

Talent.Name: Need to Know
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, when making a Leadership skill check, the character may use Deception instead of Leadership. The character's Deception skill is combined with their Presence Characteristic to form the dice pool.

Talent.Name: No Loose Ends
Talent.Description: Once per session when making a check that utilizes an intelligence or contact network, spend a Destiny Point to remove [SE] equal to the character's ranks of Willpower, or to have a failed check succeed as if a single [SU] had been the result. If they do, reduce the intelligence network by one member or the contact network's scope by one.

Talent.Name: Plans Within Plans
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Warfare)[b] or [B]Streetwise check[b] to establish a previously unknown covert plan that is coming to fruition during this encounter. Add [SU] or [FA] to one plan-related made during this encounter, plus one check for each [SU][SU] past the first.

Talent.Name: Plans Within Plans (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from Plans Within Plans to choose to add [SU] or [FA] to checks affected by Plans Within Plans after they are rolled, but after results are determined, rather than before.

Talent.Name: Spymaster
Talent.Description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of a check made to create or utilize the character's contact or intelligence network.

Talent.Name: Veiled Threats
Talent.Description: Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion or Deception check[b] to upgrade the difficulty of the next check made by foes equal to Cunning. Spend [TR] to upgrade one of those foe's checks once for the rest of the encounter instead.

Talent.Name: Astute Observation
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may add [BO] equal to ranks in Astute Observation to an ally’s check.

Talent.Name: Paths Uncharted
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation check[b] to find an uncharted hyperspace route. On success, the route is either immediately ready for the character jump as an incidental, untraceable and unrepeatable by anyone but the character, or the shortest possible in both distance and time. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to pick additional effects.

Talent.Name: Hot Swap
Talent.Description: After changing weapons, add [BO] per rank of Hot Swap to the next attack made with weapons not yet used in this encounter.

Talent.Name: Imposing Leader
Talent.Description: Suffer 2 strain to make a Leadership check with Willpower instead of Presence.

Talent.Name: Negative Reinforcement
Talent.Description: Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion or Leadership check[b]. On success, characters equal to Willpower suffer 1 strain and add [AD] to their next check if an ally, or [TH] if a foe.

Talent.Name: Willbreaker (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, if Willbreaker would affect a foe already at 1 Willpower, spend a Destiny point to incapacitate them.

Talent.Name: Willbreaker
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from melee attacks or Coercion checks to reduce a target’s Willpower by 1 until the end of the encounter (to a minimum of 1). Spend an additional [TR] to reduce it by two instead.

Talent.Name: Make An Offer...
Talent.Description:
Once per encounter before making a social check, spend a Destiny point to add [BO] equal to ranks of Knowledge (Underworld) to the check.
A character should describe what information or leverage they have on the target of the check.

Talent.Name: Iron-Willed
Talent.Description: Once per session, suffer 2 strain to treat the character as if their Willpower was one higher until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: ...They Can't Refuse
Talent.Description: Once per session, before making a social check, suffer 3 strain to substitute Coercion instead of the required skill. On success, add [DE] to a target’s next check.

Talent.Name: Negative Reinforcement (Improved)
Talent.Description: The difficulty of Negative Reinforcement is reduced to [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b]. Spend [TR] to double the number of [AD] and [TH] added.

Talent.Name: Cyber Colossus
Talent.Description: Once per session as a maneuver, make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b] to ignore the effects of damaged or missing cybernetics until the end of the encounter. This includes the effects of critical injuries that affect one or more cybernetics.

Talent.Name: Cyber Junky
Talent.Description: Decrease the difficulty of checks to install cybernetics on the character once per rank of Cyberjunky. Cybernetics cost 50% less to build, purchase, or repair. This discount does not increase with multiple ranks.

Talent.Name: Limit Breaker
Talent.Description: Once per round after performing the Move maneuver, the character may suffer 2 wounds to perform an additional Move maneuver. This may allow the character to make more than 2 maneuvers per turn.

Talent.Name: Limit Breaker (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after making a combat check, the character may spend a Destiny Point and suffer 4 wounds to make an additional attack using the same weapon(s).

Talent.Name: Unnatural Reflexes
Talent.Description: Once per round when targeted by a combat check by an enemy within long range, spend a Destiny Point to upgrade the difficulty of the check a number of times equal to the character's ranks in Vigilance.

Talent.Name: Galaxy Mapper
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Galaxy Mapper from Astrogation checks. Astrogation checks take half of the normal time.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Signature Vehicle
Talent.Description: Choose one starship or vehicle as Signature Vehicle. Upgrade all Mechanics checks made on that vehicle once.

Mod.MiscDesc: Upgrade the ability of all Mechanics checks made to work on this vehicle once.

Talent.Name: Street Smarts
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Street Smarts from Streetwise or Knowledge (Underworld) checks.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Improvised Concoction
Talent.Description: Once per session, as an action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check[b], adding [FO] no greater than Force rating to create 1 dose of a poison or drug with rarity of Intellect + [SU] + [FP] spent or lower.

Talent.Name: Secret Lore
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank or Secret Lore from all Knowledge (Lore) checks. Reduce the difficulty of all Knowledge (Lore) checks by 1.

Talent.Name: Benevolent Patronage
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI] Charm or Negotiation check[b] to invoke the aid of a powerful patron to resolve a social, legal, or logistical problem. The patron may have conditions of this assistance, per GM discretion. The character may gain +1 obligation to the patron, or upgrade the difficulty of all social checks made against this patron once until this condition is met.

Talent.Name: Exude Confidence
Talent.Description: When an incoming social check generates [TH][TH] or [DE], suffer strain up to ranks of Cool to add [FA] or [SU] to the next check by that many characters within medium range.

Talent.Name: Friends in Low Places (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, suffer strain up to ranks in Friends in Low Places to decrease the difficulty of a check to interact with the criminal element that many times, to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI]).[b]

Talent.Name: Power Broker
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, suffer 2 strain to add [SU] to a social check that invokes a patron or organization, or to interact with members of that organization.

Talent.Name: Power Broker (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session when activating Power Broker, suffer 4 strain instead to add [TR] rather than [SU].

Talent.Name: Scapegoat
Talent.Description: Once per session after making a social check, spend a Destiny Point to remove [DE], or [TH] equal to the character's ranks of Deception from the results. If the character has implicated a present character, they add the removed symbols to their next check.

Talent.Name: Time-Splitter
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform the Time-Splitter maneuver to ignore a weapon's Slow-Firing quality this turn and upgrade the difficulty of the next check using it equal to its ranks of Slow-Firing. This may also allow the character to use a weapon that has already been fired this round by upgrading the difficulty of that attack equal to the number of times it has been fired this round.

Talent.Name: Bad Info
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make an [B]opposed Knowledge check[b] against a character in the scene. On success, the player establishes the target has acted on untrue or faulty information that the character is aware of. Until the end of session, the player made add [DE] to a single check made by the target based on that bad information. The nature of the information is up to Game Master discretion.

Talent.Name: Dirty Secrets
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Underworld) check[b] to reveal a character's dirty secret(s). On success, add [FA] to all social checks they make for the rest of the encounter. The character may spend [AD][AD] to add [TH] to those checks for each [AD][AD] spent this way.

Talent.Name: Trade In Secrets
Talent.Description: When purchasing goods or services, the character may offer information they possess to be traded in addition to glass, adding a number of [BO] to the check based on the nature and value of the information, per GM discretion. [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] may be spent to establish information of equal value being given to the character at no cost.

Talent.Name: Scrappy
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Scrappy from Skullduggery and Survival checks.

Talent.Name: Low Blow
Talent.Description: Attacks benefiting from aiming inflict an additional amount of strain equal to 1 plus ranks of Low Blow (bypassing Soak).

Talent.Name: Anything Can Kill
Talent.Description: Once per round as a maneuver, make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to discover or fashion an improvised weapon with a choice of Disorient 3, Ensnare 2, or Vicious 2. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to choose an additional quality, and spend [TR] to reduce the critical rating by 1.

Talent.Name: Creative Killer (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character does not add [TH] to combat checks due to using an improvised weapon. Increase the damage of improvised weapons by 2.

Talent.Name: Anything Can Kill (Improved)
Talent.Description: When making a combat check with an improvised weapon, destroy that weapon to add [PR] to the pool.

Talent.Name: Low Blow (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, spend a Destiny Point to remove any number of [BO] from a combat check to add that many [AD] to the check.

Talent.Name: Makashi Technique
Talent.Description: When making a check using the Lightsaber skill, the character may use Presence instead of Brawn.

Talent.Name: Ataru Technique
Talent.Description: When making a check using the Lightsaber skill, the character may use Agility instead of Brawn.

Talent.Name: Soresu Technique
Talent.Description: When making a Lightsaber skill check, the character may use Intellect instead of Brawn.

Talent.Name: Shien Technique
Talent.Description: When making a check using the Lightsaber skill, the character may use Cunning instead of Brawn.

Talent.Name: Niman Technique
Talent.Description: When making a Lightsaber skill check, the character may use Willpower instead of Brawn.

Talent.Name: Renegade Form
Talent.Description: When the character purchases this talent, they choose one characteristic. They may use this characteristic in place of Brawn when making Lightsaber checks .

Talent.Name: Blackout
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Computers check[b] to disrupt enemy communications. Add [SE] to all checks made by opposing forces for rounds equal to [SU]. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to add [FA] to the next check each foe makes.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Blackout (Improved)
Talent.Description: Decrease the difficulty of Blackout to [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]).[b] Additionally, spend [TR] to keep an enemy leader from upgrading the next ability or difficulty of the next Mass Combat check made this encounter.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Counter-Intelligence
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge Warfare check[b] to disseminate false military info. On success, may add [DE] to a relevant check made by the misled faction before the end of this session. The character must establish how the information gets to said enemy.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Critical Vulnerability
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers check[b]. If successful, one computer-attached device or security system (subject to the GM's approval) fails or has its functionality fundamentally altered, either due to the character's involvement or because it was about to fail anyway.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Disruptive (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after a foe makes a check that includes a computer system the character owns or has accessed this encounter, spend a Destiny Point to have that foe reroll a number of positive dice equal to the character's ranks of Disruptive, keeping the new results.
Talent.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

Talent.Name: Jetpack Expertise
Talent.Description: The character may spend [AD] from checks they make to remove 1 system strain from a jetpack they are equipped with. (They may choose this effect multiple times when spending [AD].)

Talent.Name: Hit and Run
Talent.Description: While the character is using a jetpack, after they complete an attack targeting an opponent they are engaged with, the character may immediately disengage as an incidental.

Talent.Name: Death from Above
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while using a jetpack, the character may take the Death from Above action, inflicting 1 system strain on their jetpack and making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Piloting (Planetary) check[b]. If the check is successful, for each [SU], one adversary of silhouette 0 or 1 within short range is knocked prone. The character may spend [TR] from the check to stagger one affected adversary until the end of the adversary's next turn.

Talent.Name: To the Death!
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may take the To the Death! maneuver, suffering strain no greater than their Willpower rating. For each strain suffered this way, add +10 to Critical Injury rolls the character inflicts and suffers until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Momentum
Talent.Description: When making a melee attack, the character deals additional damage equal to the number of range bands they moved during the current round.

Talent.Name: Side Step (Improved)
Talent.Description: When the character performs a Side Step maneuver, until the start of their next turn, they may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from a combat check targeting them to inflict one hit on that attacker from a Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) weapon the character is currently wielding. The hit deals its base damage plus any damage from applicable talents or abilities. This talent may not be used if the original attack incapacitates the character.

Talent.Name: Ichor Blade
Talent.Description: When the character purchases this talent, choose one Melee or Brawl weapon they possess that does not feature electronic or other high-tech parts. (For example, they could choose a sword or staff, but not a vibroknife or electrostaff.) The weapon gains the Cortosis and Pierce 2 item qualities and reduces its critical rating by one to a minimum of 1. In addition, any other character adds [SE] to checks they make to use this weapon. If the weapon is ever lost or destroyed, the character can apply Ichor Blade to a new weapon. If the weapon leaves the character's possession for longer than a single scene or encounter, it loses all effects of this talent until the character reacquires it.

Mod.MiscDesc: Any character, other than owner, adds [SE] to checks made using this weapon.

WeaponModifier.UnarmedName: Retractable Light Blaster Pistol with ICHOR!!!

Talent.Name: Ichor Blade (Improved)
Talent.Description: The weapon affected by the character's Ichor Blade talent also gains the Sunder and Defensive 1 item qualities, and increases its damage by 2.

Talent.Name: Ichor Transfusion
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform the Ichor Transfusion maneuver. The character may heal any number of their current wounds by suffering that number of strain +1. The character may instead heal any number of their current strain by suffering that number of wounds +1.

Talent.Name: Coven
Talent.Description: The character may perform the Coven maneuver. On their next Force power check, they may reroll one [FO] for each ally within short range who also possesses the Coven talent.

Talent.Name: Witchcraft
Talent.Description: The character gains a Force rating of 1. If the character already has a Force rating of 1 or higher, there is no effect.

Talent.Name: Survivor's Instincts
Talent.Description: Once per session when the character suffers a Critical injury spend 1 Destiny Point. Then the attacker must roll two results for the Critical Injury and the player choose which will apply to their character.

Talent.Name: Summon Item
Talent.Description: When the character purchases this talent, choose one item they own of encumbrance 4 or less. As a maneuver, the character can summon this item to their hand or dismiss it from their hand back to the depths of Dathomir, regardless of the character's location. Once per session, the character can spend one hour to ceremonially prepare a different item to be summoned. The character can have only one item prepared in this way at a time.

Mod.MiscDesc: As a maneuver, may summon this item from, or dismiss this item to, the depths of Dathomir, regardless of location.

Talent.Name: Savvy
Talent.Description: The character adds [BO] to Charm and Negotiation checks they make per rank of Savvy.

Talent.Name: Blather
Talent.Description: The character may take the Blather action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Deception check[b]. If the check is successful, one adversary per [SU] within medium range is disoriented for a number of rounds equal to the character's presence rating. The character may spend [TR] from the check to stagger one affected target for one round.

Talent.Name: Diplomatic Immunity
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform the Diplomatic Immunity incidental. The character spends one Destiny Point and adversaries cannot choose the character as the target of a combat check until after the end of the character's next turn. This effect ends if the character makes a combat check.

Talent.Name: Resource Allocation
Talent.Description: At the beginning of a mass combat, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm[b] or [B]Negotiation check[b] to increase their force's strength by one step for the duration of the encounter. The character may spend [TR] from the check to upgrade the ability of their force's first Mass Combat check once.

Talent.Name: Delayed Dose
Talent.Description: After a foe fails a check to resist the effects of poisons, the character may choose to delay the effects. Before the end of session as an incidental, the character may spend a Destiny Point to have the foe immediately suffer the effects of the poison, determined by the earlier check to resist. If the session ends before the character does so, the GM decides the ramifications of the poisoning.

Talent.Name: Hidden Fangs
Talent.Description: When making a combat check with a poisoned weapon, suffer 2 strain to substitute Skulduggery instead. The character's Skulduggery skill is combined with the required characteristic to form the dice pool.

Talent.Name: Neutralizer
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, suffer 3 strain to add [TR] to a check they make targeting a poisoned character, including curing a poisoned ally or attacking a foe that the character themselves poisoned.

Talent.Name: Pick Your Poison
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make a Knowledge (Xenology) or Survival check to create, extract, or source a single dose of poison from a natural environment. The difficulty is equal to a check made to buy it, based on rarity. Spend [TR] to find a concentrated version, which adds [FA] to any checks made to resist it this session.

Talent.Name: Potent Tinctures (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend [DE] from a check made to resist a poison the character created or administered to have the foe suffer a Critical Injury, adding +10 times the Character's Cunning to the result. Additional [DE] may be spent to add an additional +10 times the character's Cunning.

Talent.Name: Potent Tinctures (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to force a foe to re-roll a check to resist a poison the character created or administered.

Talent.Name: Bad Influence
Talent.Description: Spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from a foe's social check to upgrade the ability of social checks the character makes against that character until the end of the encounter. This may only be used once per character per encounter.

Talent.Name: Bad Trip
Talent.Description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to add [DE] to a check made by a character who is under the influence of or has been exposed to drugs or similar substance.

Talent.Name: First One is Free
Talent.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check[b] to identify a nearby desperate spice-user. On success, they will perform a favor in exchange for one or more doses of an illicit substance, with the amount depending on the danger or legal status of the favor, at GM's discretion.

Talent.Name: Spice of Life
Talent.Description: Once per round per character, the character or an ally under the influence of drugs created or supplied by the character may suffer 2 strain as an incidental to add [SU] to their next check.

Talent.Name: Spice of Life (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, a character under the influence of the character's drugs may suffer 2 strain and upgrade the difficulty of the check once to add [TR] instead.

Talent.Name: Sidearm Diplomacy
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may upgrade the difficulty of a social check the character makes once to add [SU] equal to ranks in Sidearm Diplomacy to the results.

Talent.Name: Breakthrough
Talent.Description: Once per session when making a check to solve a mystery, the character may spend a Destiny Point to add [BO] equal to the number of clues the character has discovered, to a maximum of [BO][BO][BO][BO][BO]. What constitutes a clue is up to GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Chase the Lead
Talent.Description: Once per session when investigating a crime, case or mystery, the character may introduce a new source, witness, or clue that assists with the investigation as if a Destiny Point had been spent. The provenance of this new information is per GM discretion, but should meaningfully assist the character's aims.

Talent.Name: Cross-Examine
Talent.Description: When targeted by a social check, may spend [TH][TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to add [FA] to social checks the character makes until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Deductive Reasoning
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education)[b] or [B]Perception check[b] to connect a target to a location or event. The character may ask the GM a general question about the target's background for each [SU], and about the target's emotional state for each [AD]. [TR] may be spent to ask specific questions relating to an event or investigation.

Talent.Name: Inquiring
Talent.Description: When investigating a case add [BO] or remove [SE] from the check per rank of Inquiring.

Talent.Name: Inquiring (Improved)
Talent.Description: Before rolling a social check while investigating a crime, the character may remove [BO] up to their ranks in Inquiring from the pool, and add an equal number of [SU] or [AD] results (in any combination) to the results.

Talent.Name: Bloodlust
Talent.Description: After incapacitating or inflicting a Critical Injury on a foe, add [BO] per rank of Bloodlust to the next check the character makes this encounter.

Talent.Name: Historian
Talent.Description: When recalling information about or interacting with ancient or abandoned places or things, add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Historian.

Talent.Name: Bargain Hunter
Talent.Description: When the character makes a check to purchase or sell goods or services, they add [BO] or remove [SE] equal to their ranks of Bargain Hunter.

Talent.Name: More Machine Than Man (Improved)
Talent.Description: Before making a check, suffer strain up to half of the the number of character's installed cybernetics, rounded up, and add that many [BO] to the check. The player must specify how one or more of their cybernetics are aiding them for this check.

Talent.Name: Droid Commander (Improved)
Talent.Description: As an action, may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Leadership check[b]; 6 allies may immediately suffer 1 strain to perform a free maneuver; may spend [TR] to allow one ally to perform an action; once per encounter, perform as a maneuver but affect only droid allies.

Talent.Name: Ingrained Loyalty
Talent.Description: When the character makes a Leadership check targeting one or more clones and no other characters, they may change the result of one [CH] to any non-blank face.

Talent.Name: There Is No Try
Talent.Description: Once per session before any ally rolls the dice for a check, the character may spend a Destiny Point to allow the ally to automatically succeed at the check with one success and no other results.

Talent.Name: Formation Tactics (Improved)
Talent.Description: The difficulty of taking the Formation Tactics action is reduced to [B]Average ([DI][DI][b] instead of [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI])[b]. The character may also spend a [TR] or [AD][AD][AD][AD][AD][AD] results to have the effect last until end of encounter.

Talent.Name: Center of Being (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When the character performs the Center of Being maneuver, until the beginning of their next turn, ranged weapons also treat their critical rating as one higher per rank of Center of Being when attacking the character.

Talent.Name: Clanker Killer (Improved)
Talent.Description: When making a Brawl or Melee combat check targeting a droid, the character treats their attack's critical rating as being 1 lower per rank of Clanker Killer (to a minimum of 1).

Talent.Name: At Any Cost
Talent.Description: The character may suffer a Critical Injury to force a Mass Combat check to be rerolled. At the GM's discretion, the character may be required to sacrifice an item, vehicle, or individual of personal significance instead.

Talent.Name: Bound Together
Talent.Description: The character may perform the Bound Together maneuver. Until the start of the character's next turn, when the character or an ally within short range suffers strain involuntarily, they reduce the amount suffered by the current number of light side Destiny Points in the destiny pool.

Talent.Name: Get the Drop
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character and any number of allies in the current encounter may add [SU] equal to the character's ranks in Stealth to a check to determine Initiative order. The player must explain how their character's stealthy approach helps the PCs to get the drop on their opponents.

Talent.Name: Powerful Ally
Talent.Description: The character may spend a Destiny Point to use the basic version of a Force power they have not purchased or to apply the effects of a single unpurchased control upgrade to a power they have purchased.

Talent.Name: Fall Back!
Talent.Description: While engaged with an opponent, the character may suffer a number of strain up to their ranks in Leadership to allow an equal number of allies to immediately disengage from that opponent as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Natural Commando
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may reroll one Ranged (Light) or Stealth check.

Talent.Name: Stand Firm!
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may take the Stand Firm! action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) difficulty Leadership check[b]. If the check is successful, the character chooses one ally within medium range for each [SU] on the check. Until the end of the encounter, chosen allies increase their wound threshold by an amount equal to the character's Presence rating. (Multiple uses of this talent are not cumulative.)

Talent.Name: Stand Firm! (Improved)
Talent.Description: Allies affected by Stand Firm! also increase their strain threshold by an amount equal to the character's Presence rating. (Multiple uses of this talent are not cumulative.)

Talent.Name: Master of the Order
Talent.Description: The character may spend two Destiny Points during a single action.

Talent.Name: Tactical Evasion
Talent.Description: Upgrade the difficulty of any ranged combat checks targeting the character a number of times equal to the number of maneuvers the character has performed to move during the current round.

Talent.Name: Flows Through All Things
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may perform the Flows through all Things maneuver to recover strain equal to their Force rating.

Talent.Name: Practiced Strategist
Talent.Description: Once per session during a mass combat or combat encounter, the character may take the Practiced Strategist action, making an [B]opposed Knowledge (Warfare) versus Knowledge (Warfare) check[b] targeting the leader of the enemy forces. If the check succeeds, the character (or player) reveals a narrative advantage provided by their strategic planning, such as the timely arrival of reinforcements, sabotage of the enemy's equipment, or a spy planted within the enemy ranks. The exact nature of the revelation is ultimately at the GM's discretion, but it should provide the character and their allies with a significant advantage in the encounter or session.

Talent.Name: Preemptive Intervention
Talent.Description: Immediately after an opponent moves to engage an ally within short range of the character, the character may spend one Destiny Point to engage that opponent as an out-of-turn incidental.

Talent.Name: Rapid Fire
Talent.Description: Before making a Ranged (Light) combat check using a weapon that does not have the Limited Ammo item quality, the character may perform the Rapid Fire incidental to add the Auto-fire item quality to the attack. After resolving the attack, the weapon runs out of ammo.

Talent.Name: Formation Tactics
Talent.Description: The character may take the Formation Tactics action by making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) difficulty Leadership check[b]. If successful, they may choose a number of allies within short range equal to [SU] generated. The difficulty of attacks against these allies is upgraded once until the end of the character's next turn. The effects of this action do not stack.

Talent.Name: Enduring Presence
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may upgrade the ability of a Mass Combat check (if they are the commander of the acting force) or the difficulty of a Mass Combat check (if they are commander of the enemy force) even if the character is not present or is prevented from communicating with their troops.

Talent.Name: Inspiring Kill
Talent.Description: The character may spend one Destiny Point to perform an Inspiring Kill maneuver immediately after conducting a successful attack in which the target is incapacitated or suffers a Critical Injury. The character rolls [FO] no greater than their Force rating, and may spend [FP] to heal 2 strain from allies within medium range (and may do so multiple times). If the rules for Morality in [B]Force and Destiny[b] are in use, a character who has purchased this talent gains 1 Conflict at the beginning of each game session.

Talent.Name: Field Tester*
Talent.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Field Tester from checks made using equipment or vessels the character has repaired or improved this session.

Talent.Name: Keep Them Talking (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from an opposed social check to add [SU][AD] to all checks targeting that character this encounter.

Talent.Name: Quick Witted
Talent.Description: Once per session after failing a Deception or Stealth check, the character may reroll the check using Cool. The difficulty of the Cool check is the same as the original check.

Talent.Name: No Time to Die
Talent.Description: Once per session, as a maneuver, spend a Destiny Point to recover strain and/or wounds in any combination up to ranks in Cool or Discipline.

Talent.Name: Keep Them Talking
Talent.Description: When opposing a social check, may substitute Cool instead of Discipline or Vigilance.

Talent.Name: Tools of the Tradecraft
Talent.Description: The character may spend a Destiny Point, upon doing so they may declare that an item in their possession has a secret secondary use or feature. Players and GMs are encouraged to treat this like a Gear Attachment as per page 58 of Cyphers and Masks, but GM has final say on the device and its usage. The item doesn’t need to be an actual declared item but could be something they would have on them like a chronometer. If secondary use is as a weapon, it counts as an improvised weapon.

Talent.Name: Suave And Sophisticated
Talent.Description: May suffer 2 strain to make a Deception check with Presence instead of Cunning.

Talent.Name: Animal Handler (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per round, the character may suffer 1 strain to perform the Animal Handler maneuver as an incidental. Additionally, the range of Animal Handler extends to medium.

Talent.Name: Disarming Personality (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may suffer 3 strain to add :success::advantage: to a check made to a social or combat check made to disarm a foe.

Talent.Name: Living Holocron
Talent.Description: Once per session as an action, roll [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to decrease the difficulty of all knowledge checks made this encounter once, to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].

Talent.Name: Encouraging Words (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per session, when an ally within medium range would fail a check while benefiting from the character's assistance, that ally may reroll the check using the character's Charm or Leadership instead of the required skill.

Talent.Name: Empty The Self (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may decrease the difficulty of a check affected by Empty The Self once.

Talent.Name: Empty The Self
Talent.Description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain and perform the Empty The Self maneuver to remove [SE][SE] from the next check they make this round.

Talent.Name: Block
Talent.Description: When hit by a melee attack, suffer 3 strain to reduce damage by 4. This talent may only be used once per hit and when the character is wielding a Melee or other appropriate item, per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: One With The Universe (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may suffer strain up to their ranks of Astrogation to treat that many [DA] as if they were [LI], or that many [LI] as if they were [DA].

Talent.Name: Encouraging Words (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per round when an ally benefiting from the character's assistance succeeds on a check, the character and that ally recover one strain. Additionally, the range of Encouraging Words is increased to medium.

Talent.Name: Soothing Presence (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may spend [FP] on strain recovery checks to have the character or the chosen ally recover one wound. [FP] generated from [DA] inflicts strain on all healed allies.

Talent.Name: Soothing Presence (Supreme)
Talent.Description: When the character spends [FP] to heal an ally’s wounds and/or strain during strain recovery checks effects, they heal a number of allies equal to their Willpower instead. Once per session, per GM discretion, the character may spend [FP][FP][FP] to reduce the current amount of conflict being suffered by all affected allies by 1.

Talent.Name: Condemnation
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may make an [B]opposed Discipline vs Cool combined Force check[b] against a target within short range, learning their true intent and character. On success, the target adds [TH] to all social checks they make this encounter, plus an additional [TH] for each [SU][SU] past the first. Spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to add [FA] to those checks. Spend [FP] to inflict one strain for each [FP] spent this way.

Talent.Name: Animal Handler
Talent.Description: Once per round as a maneuver, the character may suffer strain no more than their ranks in Animal Handler. Upgrade the ability of the next check made by a friendly creature within short range a number of times equal to strain suffered.

Talent.Name: One With The Universe (Improved)
Talent.Description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from One With The Universe to add [SU] to each combined Force check the character makes this encounter.

Talent.Name: Sage Advice (Improved)
Talent.Description: When taking the Sage Advice action, the character may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to decrease the difficulty of the next check made by an additional ally once per [AD][AD] or [TR] spent.

Talent.Name: The Greatest Teacher
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after failing a skill check, the character may suffer 4 strain to add [TR] to the next check the character or an ally within medium range makes using that skill.

Talent.Name: Harmonious Being
Talent.Description: Once per round, when targeting an ally with a Force power or Force Talent, may suffer 2 strain to add [DA] or [LI] to the pool.

Talent.Name: The Sum of All Knowledge
Talent.Description: Once per encounter after failing a Knowledge check, may reroll the check using a different Knowledge skill, increasing the difficulty of the check twice.

Talent.Name: Well Rounded (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may spend a Destiny Point to treat their skill ranks in a career skill as if it were one rank higher (to a maximum of 5) until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: Stubbon Like A Bantha
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may spend a Destiny Point and choose a friendly non-sentient creature within short range. The character’s Brawn and soak becomes equal to that creature’s Brawn and soak for rounds equal to the character’s ranks in Resilience until the end of the encounter.

Talent.Name: The Stars Align
Talent.Description: Once per encounter as a maneuver, the character may commit one or more [FO]. On a later turn, the character may uncommit one or more [FO] committed this way to add [SU], [AD][AD], [LI], or [DA] for each [FO] uncommitted to a check made by an ally within medium range.

Talent.Name: Nerf Whisperer
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b]. On Success, they treat all friendly non-sentient creatures within medium range as the character’s Animal Companion until the end of the encounter, extending the benefits of all Animal Companion and related talents. When directing these animals while this effect is active, the character treats them all as if they were a single entity, per GM discretion.

Talent.Name: Scruffy
Talent.Description: Add [BO] to Athletics and Resilience checks the character makes per ranks of Scruffy.

Talent.Name: Soothing Presence
Talent.Description: May add [FO] no greater than Force rating to checks to recover strain. Spend [LI] to heal or have target ally recover 1 strain.

Talent.Name: Good Relations
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may suffer 2 strain to remove [DE], or [TH] equal to their ranks of Knowledge (Xenology), from a social check made by a character within short range. The character should justify this with cultural knowledge of one of the present parties.

Talent.Name: The Stars Align (Improved)
Talent.Description: When uncommitting [FO] committed to The Stars Align, may uncommit [FO][FO][FO] to add [TR] to an allied check.

Talent.Name: Researcher (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may spend a Destiny Point to make a Knowledge check as an incidental.

Talent.Name: Vital Force
Talent.Description: Once per session when an ally within medium range exceeds wound threshold, may make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check[b]. The target recovers wounds equal to [SU]. Spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to have them not suffer a critical injury.

Talent.Name: Unarmed Block
Talent.Description: May Block while unarmed. Reduce strain cost to Block while unarmed by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

Talent.Name: Purification
Talent.Description: The character may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check[b], adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. On success, the character may spend [FP] to remove a status condition from an ally within short range for every [FP] spent this way. If the ally is poisoned, the difficulty to purify is the original difficulty to resist the poison. Alternatively, this action may be used to purify food or water, rendering it safe to consume.

Talent.Name: Unarmed Block (Improved)
Talent.Description: When a combat check made by an engaged foe generates [TH][TH][TH] or [DE], may disarm the attacker and may equip that weapon.

Talent.Name: Sage Advice
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Charm check[b]. On success, reduce the difficulty of the next check made by an ally within medium range once.

Talent.Name: Deeper Understanding
Talent.Description: Add [BO] per rank of Deeper Understanding to Astrogation and Knowledge (Lore) checks.

Talent.Name: Master Curator
Talent.Description: When making a Perception or Computers check to discover or recover information, suffer strain up to ranks of a Knowledge skill to add that many [BO] to the check.

Talent.Name: Disarming Personality (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per session after disarming or nonlethally incapacitating a foe, the character may spend a Destiny point to force a number of targets equal to twice the character's Force rating to cease actively attacking or pursuing hostile intent. A target of a higher tier may not be swayed by a lower-tier NPC being disarmed or dispatched, per GM discretion. This ceasefire or parley may require subsequent checks to maintain, or may return to active hostilities.

Talent.Name: Master Healer
Talent.Description: Once per encounter while making a Heal Power check, may suffer 3 strain to apply the effects of the Physician and Surgeon talents.

Talent.Name: Disarming Personality
Talent.Description: The character removes [SE][SE] from called shot attacks to destroy the weapon, checks to remove them physically or with the Force, or Social checks to checks to convince the target to disarm.

Talent.Name: Unconventional Solution
Talent.Description: Once per session as a maneuver, choose a skill and make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check.[b] The character may substitute a different characteristic when making checks using that skill this encounter.

Talent.Name: Sly As A Tooka
Talent.Description: Once per encounter when making a Charm or Negotiation skill check, the character may use Cunning instead.

Talent.Name: Living Holocron (Improved)
Talent.Description: The character may suffer 2 strain to perform the Living Holocron action as a maneuver. Additionally, spend [FP][FP][FP] instead of [FP] to decrease the difficulty of all knowledge checks they make by 2 instead, to a minimum of [B]Simple ()[b].

Talent.Name: There Is Only The Force
Talent.Description: Once per session when the character would be incapacitated, the character may spend a Destiny point to make a Force power check as an out-of-turn incidental. If it is successful, add [TR] to the result.

Talent.Name: Empty The Self (Supreme)
Talent.Description: Once per session, the character may add [FO] to a check affected by Empty The Self no greater than their Force Rating, and may spend [FP] to add [SU] and/ or [AD] to the result, but only one of each symbol. Additionally, [FP][FP] may be spent to add [SU][AD] to the check.

Talent.Name: Animal Handler (Supreme)
Talent.Description: The first time the character activates Animal Handler each round, the targeted creature recovers 2 strain. Additionally, the range of Animal Handler extends to long range.

Talent.Name: Unconventional Solution (Improved)
Talent.Description: When performing the Unconventional Solution maneuver, an ally within medium range may also substitute a characteristic for skill of their choosing, and may choose a different characteristic for that skill.

Talent.Name: Deflect
Talent.Description: When hit by a ranged attack, suffer 3 strain to reduce damage by 4.

Talent.Name: Physician (Improved)
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, the character may spend [AD][AD], [TR], or [FP][FP] from a Medicine or Heal Power check to have the target add [AD] equal to ranks of Physician to their next check.

Talent.Name: It's A Long Story
Talent.Description: Once per encounter, may suffer 2 strain to add [BO] equal to ranks of Knowledge (Lore) to a social check made to delay, distract, or confuse. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from that check to stagger the target.
